title: Certified Implementation Specialist - Human Resources
description: Practice 229 verified questions across all topics in Certified Implementation Specialist - Human Resources.

questions.question: For bulk cases, which Status label is assigned to a User who no longer meets the criteria defined in User Segments?
questions.explanation:
A user who no longer meets the defined User Segment criteria is excluded from the bulk case, so the appropriate status label is Excluded.

**Learn more:** [What Else Is New for HR Service Delivery in the Rome Release?](https://www.servicenow.com/community/hrsd-blog/what-else-is-new-for-hr-service-delivery-in-the-rome-release/ba-p/2280168)

questions.question: What actions can an HR Admin who does not have the System Admin role perform? (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: Grant roles to users or groups

questions.explanation:
The HR Administrator role can configure HR Service Delivery properties, create HR Criteria records, and associate users with HR groups. Password resets and general user-role administration require user-administration privileges, and business-rule configuration is a platform-development capability outside the base HR Administrator role.

**Learn more:** [HR properties](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/SogDT~k7ktsbe1ZYegnaLg/HAeCt96sW297ctXsfz3I_Q) · [HR criteria](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-criteria.html)

questions.question: Which settings define and track cross-scope access to applications?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Restricted Caller Access (RCA) privilege settings define cross-scope access to applications and resources, while `sys_restricted_caller_access` records track cross-scope access requests from applications or scripts.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Restricted caller access privilege settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/restricted-caller-access-privilege.html)

questions.question: If an HR Document needs to be generated manually for an HR Case, who can generate the document from the Case record?

options.label: A
options.text: Only an HR Admin can generate Documents from a Case

options.label: B
options.text: Any HR professional can generate the Document, even if they are not assigned to the Case

options.label: C
options.text: Only the assigned to person can manually generate Documents from a Case

options.label: D
options.text: Only the Manager of the assignment group can generate the Document

questions.explanation:
Manual HR case document generation is performed by the HR agent assigned to the case. The Assigned to field identifies the user responsible for working the case; being an HR administrator, another HR professional, or the assignment-group manager does not by itself grant this case-level action.

**Learn more:** [HR document generation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/DocumentGeneration.html?contentId=dxJHnEGWzq1P0oyvDss8cg) · [Create case in Classic HR Service Delivery Agent Workspace](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/agent-ws-hr-create-case.html)

questions.question: When the Lifecycle Events application is installed, to which role is the LE Admin role granted?

options.label: B
options.text: It is not added to other roles

questions.explanation: Installing Lifecycle Events grants the LE Admin role (`sn_hr_le.admin`) to the HR Admin role (`sn_hr_core.admin`), allowing HR administrators to administer Lifecycle Events.

questions.question: When **Advanced** is selected as an Activity Set Trigger Condition, which additional field or fields are displayed?
questions.explanation:
The Advanced trigger condition uses a custom script to determine when an activity set triggers, so it displays the **Trigger script** field.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Configure a lifecycle event activity set](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/SogDT~k7ktsbe1ZYegnaLg/3PD7VHJRvjtQU0CEjfbsKw)

questions.question: If a customer has a very large employee population, complex organizational structures, and needs custom integrations and language translations, what level of configuration complexity would the project be considered?
questions.explanation: Drastic configuration complexity applies to projects with an exceptionally large employee population and complex organizational structure that also require custom integrations and language translations.

questions.question: Which of the following are examples of HR application scopes? *(select 4)*
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow HR Service Delivery separates HR functionality into scoped applications. Human Resources: Core provides foundational HR case and knowledge capabilities and activates HR Integrations; Human Resources: Knowledge, Human Resources: Integrations, and Human Resources: Lifecycle Events are HR application scopes. A Center of Excellence is used to organize HR services and cases, while Global is the instance-wide application scope.

**Learn more:** [Activate Case and Knowledge Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/activate-case-and-knowledge-management-scoped.html) · [Components installed with Lifecycle Events](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/components-installed-with-enterprise-onboarding-and-transitions.html)

questions.question: In which module can HR Profiles be created for multiple employees using conditions and criteria?
questions.explanation:
The **Generate HR Profiles** module creates HR profiles for multiple employees selected through defined conditions and criteria. [ServiceNow: Generate HR Profiles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_GenHRProfile.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Generate HR Profiles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_GenHRProfile.html)

questions.question:
In the base ServiceNow platform, the Human Resources General Knowledge base has its Can Contribute User Criteria set to users who hold the [sn_hr_core.kb_write] role.

If a Knowledge article in the Human Resources General Knowledge base has no Can Contribute User Criteria configured, what is the minimum role a user needs to edit that article?
questions.explanation:
Can Contribute access at the knowledge-base level permits users to create, modify, and retire articles in that base. The configured criterion requires the HR knowledge write permission; the HR Basic KB Writer role is the minimum listed role that grants this contribution capability. Article-level criteria do not replace the base-level contribution requirement.

**Learn more:** [Managing access to knowledge bases and knowledge articles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/user-access-knowledge.html)

questions.question: Which field on an HR Service record specifies the HR Catalog Item associated with that Service?
questions.explanation:
An HR catalog item is a record producer in HR Service Delivery. The **Record Producer** field on an HR Service associates that service with the catalog item presented to employees; a template only provides predefined values for the resulting HR case.

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-service.html) · [HR catalog item configuration](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/SogDT~k7ktsbe1ZYegnaLg/WI6IF~lPPWNcaDDYajYjQw)

questions.question: What determines the path a Case or HR Task follows when it is escalated?
questions.explanation:
Escalation Rules define the tier-to-tier escalation process, including the originating tier and the tier to which the work is escalated.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Add or modify escalation rules](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/NqJp~1rO7N5HB4FGXarrFA/VM1EWPtzwmk6IVUfDTI8wQ)

questions.question: Which role is needed to access the modules in the HR Integrations application?
questions.explanation:
The **HR integrations administrator** role (`sn_hr_integrations.admin`) grants access to and configuration capability for the HR Integrations application.

**Learn more:** [Components installed with HR Integrations](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/components-installed-with-hr-integrations.html?contentId=KoJSVsp0YZoHejQFlq6cHQ)

questions.question: Which table serves as the core table for all HR Case records?
questions.explanation:
The HR Case table (`sn_hr_core_case`) is the foundational table for HR case records. HR Centers of Excellence extend this table to provide specialized HR case types.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow HR services](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-administration.html)

questions.question: What is the purpose of the **Template** field referenced on the HR Service record?

options.label: A
options.text: Populate fields on the HR Case record

options.label: B
options.text: Filter who can access the HR Service

options.label: C
options.text: Create pre-configured responses HR professionals can use

options.label: D
options.text: Make the HR Service accessible on the Employee Service Center

questions.explanation:
The Template field identifies the HR case template for the service. When someone requests that HR service, the HR case template automatically populates fields on the HR case form.

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-service.html)

questions.question: What does the template field referenced on the HR Service record accomplish?

options.label: A
options.text: Populate fields on a Journey task

options.label: C
options.text: Populate fields on the HR Profile

options.label: D
options.text: Populate fields on the HR Case record

questions.explanation:
An HR service uses an HR case template to automatically populate fields on the HR case form when a request for that service is made.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow HR templates](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-template-configuration.html)

questions.question: Which base-instance application provides the results of current-state metrics?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Reporting displays the current state of table data, whereas Performance Analytics is designed to track indicator scores and trends over time. The base-instance application for current-state HR reporting is HR Reports.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Reporting](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/now-intelligence/reporting/reporting-landing-page.html) · [Reporting compared to Performance Analytics](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/now-intelligence/reporting/reporting-vs-pa.html)

questions.question: Which Lifecycle Event activity type lets you manage activity dependencies or the order of activities within an activity set?
questions.explanation: An activity container groups related Lifecycle Event activities and enables their dependencies and execution order to be managed within an activity set.

questions.question: With the base HRSD configuration and no integrations, when the subject person electronically signs an HR document or PDF document, how is the signature saved?

options.label: B
options.text: a picture of the signature that is added to the document

questions.explanation:
Base HRSD captures the subject person's typed or drawn electronic signature as a signature image that is inserted into the HR or PDF document. Cryptographic digital signatures, keys, and certificates require capabilities beyond this base signature capture.

**Learn more:** [Signature pad for HR](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/signature-pad/concept/signature-pad.html) · [Fill and sign a PDF document](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/fill-sign-document.html)

questions.question: What is the function of Trigger conditions in activity sets?

options.label: A
options.text: It defines specific employees to the activity set targets.

options.label: B
options.text: It defines when the activity set should be initiated.

options.label: C
options.text: It defines order number for the activity set.

options.label: D
options.text: It defines the relationships between fields in various tables.

questions.explanation: Trigger conditions define the event or criteria under which an activity set is initiated.

questions.question: Which plugin permits agent tasking only inside the HR department?

options.label: B
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events]

options.label: C
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent]

options.label: D
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Employee Relations [com.sn_hr_employee_relations]

questions.explanation:
Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events (`com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events`) is the HR-only Lifecycle Events option. The Enterprise Lifecycle Events offering is designed for lifecycle events that span departments such as IT, Facilities, Finance, and Legal, whereas the standard Lifecycle Events plugin is limited to HR-department tasking.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: List of plugins (Yokohama)](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/platform-administration/list-of-plugins.html)

questions.question: Which application is used to send prompts to managers and employees as they work?
questions.explanation:
Proactive Prompts delivers contextual, actionable prompts to managers and employees in their flow of work.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Proactive Prompts](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/proactive-prompts/proactive-prompts-for-hrsd.html)

questions.question: Which option lets a user create a copy of a campaign?
questions.explanation: Cloning creates a new campaign by duplicating an existing campaign’s configuration, so the relevant action is **Clone Campaign**.

questions.question: If the **Applies to all services** box is not selected on the COE ACL Configuration record, what further configuration is required for that record?

options.label: B
options.text: More than one group must be added to the Groups list

options.label: C
options.text: At least one HR Service must be selected for the Services list

options.label: D
options.text: An Applies when condition must be created for each Service

questions.explanation:
Clearing **Applies to all services** limits the COE security policy to particular HR services, so at least one HR Service must be selected in the **Services** list. [ServiceNow: HR service categorization](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/human-resources/concept/hr-service-categorization.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR service categorization](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/human-resources/concept/hr-service-categorization.html)

questions.question:
The Enterprise Service Management Integrations framework includes common components for integrating HR applications with third-party systems.

Which capability does the Enterprise Service Management Integrations framework use to communicate with external instances and third-party systems?
questions.explanation:
The Enterprise Service Management Integrations Framework uses Flow Designer to communicate with external instances and third-party systems.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Enterprise Service Management Integrations Framework](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-integrations-framework.html)

questions.question: Which variable type is included when configuring an HTML document template?
questions.explanation:
Customized variables can be added from a record producer and referenced in an HTML document template. Label, masked, and multi-row variable set types are unsupported for these templates.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Variables supported in HTML document templates](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/variables-html.html) · [ServiceNow: Add customized variables in a document template](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/add-variables-html.html)

questions.question: Which method must be invoked from the `MatchingRuleProcessor` class?
questions.explanation:
The `processAndGetCandidates` method invokes the matching engine and returns the candidate resource sys_ids produced by matching rules.

**Learn more:** [Invoke the MatchingRuleProcessor API](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/customer-service-management/t_InvokeMatchingRuleAPI.html)

questions.question: If an HR Service must be available to employees in Employee Center, which field is required on the HR Service record?
questions.explanation:
A Record Producer is required to expose an existing HR service for employee self-service: it creates the HR catalog-item entry through which employees request that service. Taxonomy topics organize catalog content in Employee Center but do not replace the HR service’s Record Producer configuration. ServiceNow documents that an existing HR service is made available for employee self-service by configuring a record producer and adding it to the HR service catalog.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — HR service configuration](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-configuration.html)

questions.question: What is the main purpose of HR Topic Categories?

options.label: D
options.text: They group common HR Catalog Items.

questions.explanation:
HR Topic Categories provide the first level of categorization for HR services, grouping related services within an HR Center of Excellence. HR catalog-item categories are a separate employee-facing catalog organization. 

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR topic category](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-topic-category.html) · [HR service catalog categorization](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-catalog-categorization.html)

questions.question: Which plugin, when activated, creates several key tables that enable the HR application to integrate with third-party HR systems?

options.label: C
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events]

options.label: D
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Employee Relations [com.sn_hr_employee_relations]

questions.explanation:
Human Resources Scoped App: Integrations (`com.sn_hr_integrations`) enables HR Service Delivery integration with third-party systems and installs multiple HR integration tables upon activation.

**Learn more:** [Components installed with HR Integrations](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/components-installed-with-hr-integrations.html) · [Activate HR Integrations](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/activate-hr-integrations.html?contentId=hsR61v2RYQfapfqGTt~kBg)

questions.question: If you have both the Admin and HR Admin roles and want to configure an Access Control for the Employee Relations Cases table, what must you do first?

options.label: A
options.text: Add the Delegated Developer role to your User record

options.label: B
options.text: From the User dropdown in the banner, elevate your role to security_admin

options.label: C
options.text: Manually add the security_admin role to your User record

options.label: D
options.text: Nothing would need to be done

questions.explanation:
Creating or changing a ServiceNow Access Control List requires the elevated `security_admin` privilege. The `admin` role must elevate to `security_admin` for the current session using the banner user menu before configuring the ACL.

**Learn more:** [Configure an ACL rule](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-security/access-control/t_CreateAnACLRule.html) · [Elevate to a privileged role](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-security/t_ElevateToAPrivilegedRole.html)

questions.question:
If you choose **Data Type: Numeric Scale** on the **Assessment Metric (Survey Question)** form, a **Scale definition** field becomes visible.

What does selecting **High** for the Scale definition mean?

options.label: A
options.text: It means a high score is bad

options.label: B
options.text: It means a high score is good

options.label: C
options.text: There is no option for Scale definition

options.label: D
options.text: There is no option for High

questions.explanation:
A **High** scale definition treats greater numeric values as better assessment results; therefore, a high score is good.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Assessment Metric form for a category](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/Ir~NPf1dr8MGFXQE6QlBoQ/xb95cBIXnWQN3EGQ1Jc4Aw)

questions.question: Which HRSD application restricts agent tasking to only within the HR department?
questions.explanation:
Lifecycle Events supports digital workflows for employee lifecycle events within HR. Lifecycle Events for Enterprise extends those workflows across multiple departments, including IT, Facilities, Finance, and Legal.

**Learn more:** [Understanding Lifecycle Events for Enterprise](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-journey-management/understanding-enterprise-onboarding-and-transitions.html)

questions.question: How can a PDF document for an active HR case be generated? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
HR Service Delivery can generate a document automatically when the HR service is configured for automatic document creation. An HR agent assigned to the case can also generate the document from the case; document-generation workflows require the agent to be assigned to that case.

**Learn more:** [HR document generation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/DocumentGeneration.html) · [Generate a summary report](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/define-summary.html?contentId=r7Q~h7HKG_ygjO7q3ZAiGg)

questions.question: What benefits result from scoping the HR application? (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: Provides an additional layer of control over HR data.

options.label: B
options.text: Allows HR Admins to configure the HR application.

options.label: C
options.text: HR department has more autonomy to manage all aspects of HRSD.

options.label: D
options.text: Allows the System Administrator complete control.

options.label: E
options.text: HR department has full control of the global application.

questions.explanation:
A scoped HR application adds protection for sensitive HR data by limiting access to users with appropriate HR roles. It also lets HR administrators administer and configure HR product content, giving the HR department autonomy to manage HR Service Delivery without granting it control of the global application.

**Learn more:** [Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html) · [HR security](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-security.html)

questions.question: Lifecycle Events includes an activity set that can cancel and revert work completed in a lifecycle event case. What is this process called?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Lifecycle Events, the **rescind process** cancels a lifecycle event case and reverts work already completed through the Rescind activity set.

**Learn more:** [Configure the rescind process for a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-rescind-for-a-lifecycle-event.html)

questions.question: Which primary security aspects does the HR application focus on? (select 3)
questions.explanation: The three primary ServiceNow HR security control areas are platform access, role- and group-based access, and contextual security. Contextual security uses mechanisms such as ACLs to apply access decisions based on the data and record context, so ACL security is not a separate primary category.

questions.question:
The customer being implemented has purchased HR Service Delivery Enterprise, which includes Enterprise Onboarding and Transitions.

Which plugin must be activated to enable Lifecycle Events?

options.label: D
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent]

questions.explanation:
Enterprise Onboarding and Transitions is enabled by the Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise plugin, `com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent`. It automates onboarding and other employee lifecycle events across departments; related Core HR and Employee Center plugins are dependencies rather than the enabling Lifecycle Events for Enterprise plugin.

**Learn more:** [Activate Lifecycle Events for Enterprise](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/de-DE/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/activate-hr-lifecycle-events-for-enterprise.html)

questions.question: When configuring a Lifecycle Event, which of the following defines the relationships between fields across various tables?
questions.explanation:
Activity Field Mapping defines the source and target table fields used to pass information from a parent lifecycle event case to an activity, thereby establishing field relationships across tables.

**Learn more:** [Configure a lifecycle event activity](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-hr-lifecycle-event-activity.html?contentId=Tu969_D4ZveO1238TOIUSQ)

questions.question: What controls when the HR Chat queue is available?

options.label: A
options.text: Schedule field on the HR Profile

options.label: B
options.text: Schedule field on the User record

options.label: D
options.text: Schedule field on the Queues record

questions.explanation:
The **Schedule** field on the HR chat queue’s Queues record defines the hours during which users can start a conversation. If it is left blank, the queue is available at all times.

**Learn more:** [Manage the HR chat queue](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_ManageTheHRChatQueue.html)

questions.question: Which feature allows agents to discuss their work in the Next Experience user interface?
questions.explanation:
In Next Experience, certain communication capabilities formerly associated with Connect Chat are available through the Sidebar. This makes the Sidebar overview the applicable feature for agents to hold discussions related to their work.

**Learn more:** [Next Experience UI](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/next-experience-landing-page.html)

questions.question: What controls which Knowledge bases, Knowledge articles, and Service Catalog Items an employee is able to view?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow User Criteria control access and visibility for Knowledge bases, Knowledge articles, and Service Catalog items. A criterion evaluates whether a user meets defined conditions, such as group membership, role, department, or location.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow documentation: CMDB CI class models](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/cmdb-ci-class-models/cmdb-ci-class-models.html)

questions.question: What is used to create a link on an HR Case form that accesses information external to the application?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Link Generator creates links on HR case forms to external information and third-party applications, enabling HR agents to access information needed to fulfill a case.

**Learn more:** [Link generator for HR Service Delivery](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/HRLinkGenerator.html)

questions.question: Which method is used to configure policies that determine how long documents are retained and who they apply to?

options.label: A
options.text: Create a new policy trough COE Security

options.label: B
options.text: Create a new policy using ACLs

options.label: C
options.text: Go through Employee Documents > Document Type

options.label: D
options.text: Go through HR Service Template > Document Type

questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Employee Document Management, retention policies define how long employee documents are kept and use HR criteria to determine who they apply to. Retention policies are associated with employee document types, which are configured under Employee Documents.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Defining and setting for employee documents](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-document-management/hr-doc-management-config.html)

questions.question: Which Service Portal configuration option lets you customize the HR Service Portal’s logo, theme, and title?
questions.explanation:
The Branding Editor is used to configure a Service Portal’s branding. It provides settings for the portal title and header logo, as well as theme-color customization.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Configure portal branding](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/service-portal/c_BrandingEditor.html)

questions.question: Which role must be removed from the Admin role at go-live to keep the System Admin from viewing HR Profile information?
questions.explanation:
The HR Administrator role (`sn_hr_core.admin`) grants access to HR profiles and sensitive HR information. Removing it from the System Administrator (`admin`) role after configuration prevents System Administrators from viewing that protected information through forms, lists, and the UI.

**Learn more:** [Remove HR roles from IT Admins](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_HRRemoveAdminRole.html) · [Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html)

questions.question: If every **Can Edit Journey** permission is selected in the Journey configuration, which of the following users may modify the existing Journey? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Journey Designer grants journey-editing capability to journey owners and mentors when their respective **Can edit journey** permissions are enabled. Employees do not receive this editing capability through those permissions.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Journey Designer user permissions reference](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/SogDT~k7ktsbe1ZYegnaLg/q~VSVD5Rk4ZD4j0Az3hV8A) · [ServiceNow Journey Configuration fields reference](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xGHm5nN1KlkEq58WJHJoPw/6AkeIZW~gzUMxb9zU_xdZQ)

questions.question: Which content-delivery feature enables a user to send messages to employees and invite them to a meeting at which survey results will be shared?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Campaigns provide targeted, multi-channel internal communications to employees. A campaign can distribute notification content and links through channels such as email, SMS, push notifications, or the employee portal, making it the appropriate feature for communicating survey results and inviting employees to the related meeting.

**Learn more:** [Campaigns for Content Experiences](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/ecpro-campaigns.html) · [Creating campaigns](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/ecpro-campaigns.html)

questions.question: Scenario: Alex belongs to the HR Tier 1 group, which grants him the HR Basic [sn_hr_core.basic] role. He will be out of the office for a few days and wants to use granular delegation so that his friend Amy can complete his tasks. Amy is not yet a member of any HR groups, although she hopes to transfer into HR someday. Will granular delegation work for this purpose?

options.label: A
options.text: Yes. Granular delegation will automatically grant the necessary roles

options.label: B
options.text: Yes. Granular delegation will automatically add Amy to the HR Tier 1 group where she will inherit the role.

options.label: C
options.text: Partially. Granular delegation will allow Amy access to the HR Tasks, but not to the HR Case itself.

options.label: D
options.text: No. Granular delegation does not change a delegate's access to records.

questions.explanation:
Granular delegation does not grant a delegate roles, group membership, or record access. Delegates must already have the roles required to access the delegated records. Because Amy does not inherit the HR Basic [sn_hr_core.basic] role from HR Tier 1, delegation cannot provide the HR record access needed to complete Alex’s tasks.

**Learn more:** [Exploring Granular Delegation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/granular-delegation/granular-delegation-explore.html)

questions.question: What functions does a journey template owner perform? (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: Restrict inter-departmental transfer of sensitive case details

options.label: B
options.text: Manage the order and flow of the journey stages and tasks

options.label: C
options.text: Create task templates for their audience in a simple user-friendly experience

options.label: D
options.text: Message new hire to welcome them to the team

options.label: E
options.text: Change only the task templates that they own

questions.explanation:
Journey template owners maintain journey configurations by adding, updating, and reordering stages and by creating or changing task templates for their audience. Journey owners can also send personalized emails to employees, including new hires. Case-detail transfer restrictions are unrelated to Journey Designer, and template owners are not restricted to changing only task templates that they personally own.

**Learn more:** [Journey designer plan configuration template process, owners, and maintenance](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/human-resources/concept/jny-process-owners-maint.html) · [Journey designer release notes](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/store-release-notes/store-rn-hr-journey-designer.html)

questions.question:
An employee in Chicago submits a request through the Employee Service Center. The HR Case template linked to the HR Service specifies the required Skills, but it does not specify an Assignment Group.

Using base-platform functionality, which of the following is the system’s first step in assigning the Case?

options.label: A
options.text: An Assignment Rule creates a list of possible assignees

options.label: B
options.text: A Matching Rule assigns the Case to a group

options.label: C
options.text: The Case must be manually assigned

options.label: D
options.text: An Assignment Rule assigns the Case to a group

questions.explanation:
When an HR case template has required skills but no assignment group, HR assignment rules route the case to an HR group, such as by the submitting employee’s location. Matching rules then evaluate members of that group for the required skills, country, and case workload to select an eligible agent.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Assignment and matching rules in HR](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_UseAssignmentRules.html)

questions.question: What do Client Roles specify?

options.label: B
options.text: Roles that come into force if user uses a browser client.

options.label: C
options.text: Named roles (eg VP of Operations, SVP Sales) for a customer’s clients.

options.label: D
options.text: Access for new hires, employees, alumni, contingent, and contract workers.

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow HR Service Delivery client roles define in-application access for employee populations, including new hires, employees, alumni, contingent workers, and contractors.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Client roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ClientRoles.html)

questions.question: A customer has a group of developers who will be responsible for making subprod updates to the HR Integrations application. Customer policy states that these developers cannot be granted the System Administrator [admin] role. Which option is the best solution for granting the appropriate access required to complete development work in the HR application?

options.label: A
options.text: Grant them delegated developer role to the global application scope

options.label: B
options.text: Advise the customer this work must be completed in Production

options.label: C
options.text: Grant them delegated developer role only to the HR Integrations application scope

options.label: D
options.text: Submit an exception request to allow them to have the Admin role

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Delegated Development allows non-administrator users to develop or deploy applications while preserving platform governance. Developer permissions are assigned for a specific application, so delegating the developer role only for the HR Integrations application grants the required least-privilege access without granting the System Administrator role.

**Learn more:** [Delegated Development](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/application-development/delegated-development-and-deployment/delegated-development-landing.html) · [Developer and deployment permissions](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/delegated-development-and-deployment/developer-permissions.html)

questions.question: What does the HR Guided Setup provide?

options.label: A
options.text: A way to set up the client's HR organization

options.label: B
options.text: A list of HR policy documents

options.label: C
options.text: A sequential checklist for emergency procedures

options.label: D
options.text: A sequence of tasks to set up the HR application

questions.explanation:
HR Guided Setup provides organized configuration tasks and activities that guide administrators through setting up the HR application and tracking completion progress.

**Learn more:** [Guided setup for HR Service Delivery](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/guided-set-up-hr.html)

questions.question: Which security feature ensures limited access to a particular HR case-type table and module?
questions.explanation:
A COE Security Policy restricts read or write access to HR cases for a selected Center of Excellence and its associated HR case table, granting access only to the specified groups. ServiceNow documents that COE ACL configuration uses the COE Security Policy table to determine access to extended HR case tables.

**Learn more:** [Configure COE security policies](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-coe-security-policies.html)

questions.question: What kind of information is contained in the HR Profile?
questions.explanation: An HR Profile stores personal employee information. Access groups and roles, login details, departmental account data, and passwords are maintained in other identity, access-control, or credential records.

questions.question: What determines an employee’s access to the HR Service Portal / Employee Service Center?
questions.explanation: HR Criteria define employee eligibility for HR services and related portal content in ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, determining what an employee can access in the HR Service Portal or Employee Service Center.

questions.question: If the HR Administrator group is responsible for collecting Performance Analytics data, which additional role should be assigned to the group?
questions.explanation:
The `pa_data_collector` role authorizes users to create, schedule, and run Performance Analytics data collection jobs. It is the role required for Performance Analytics data collection. [ServiceNow Performance Analytics roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/now-intelligence/performance-analytics/r_PARoles.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Performance Analytics roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/now-intelligence/performance-analytics/r_PARoles.html) · [Create or schedule a data collection job](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/now-intelligence/performance-analytics/t_CreatASchedDataCollJob.html)

questions.question: What is the purpose of the `sys_ui_message` table?

options.label: A
options.text: To store messages and their translations

options.label: B
options.text: To store field labels and their translations

options.label: D
options.text: To store employee message responses and their translations

questions.explanation:
The `sys_ui_message` Message table stores system messages and their localized translations, such as informational, confirmation, and error messages. ServiceNow retrieves translated text from this table for message-lookup APIs such as `getMessage` and `gs.getMessage`.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Message table](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/system-localization/r_MessageTable.html)

questions.question: Which method enables a lifecycle event to be copied?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Lifecycle Events, **Clone Lifecycle Event** creates a copy of the lifecycle event together with its associated activity sets and activities.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Clone a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/clone-lifecycle-event.html)

questions.question:
When collecting requirements for HR Services, it is best to start by defining the Service and work upward, categorizing in progressively greater detail.

What basic categories are used?

options.label: B
options.text: HR Service, Topic Category, Activity Category, Activities, COE.

options.label: D
options.text: HR Service, Topic Detail, Topic Category, COE.

questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, an HR service belongs to a topic detail; the topic detail belongs to a topic category; and the topic category is associated with an HR Center of Excellence (COE). Topic categories are the first categorization level and topic details are the second. [HR service categorization](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-categorization.html), [Configure an HR topic detail](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-topic-detail.html?contentId=kLwCy3qcm8A8AC1iJQwejw)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR service categorization](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-categorization.html) · [ServiceNow: Configure an HR topic detail](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-topic-detail.html?contentId=kLwCy3qcm8A8AC1iJQwejw)

questions.question: Which HRSD application synchronizes ServiceNow with external HR systems?
questions.explanation:
HR Integrations connects HR Service Delivery with third-party HR management systems and synchronizes employee profiles, tasks, and related data. [ServiceNow: HR Integrations](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/scoped-hr-third-party-integrations.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow HR Integrations](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/scoped-hr-third-party-integrations.html)

questions.question: Which security control option uses the data context within a record to grant and/or restrict access?
questions.explanation: Access Control Level rules control access to records and can evaluate contextual record data when deciding whether a user may access the requested resource.

questions.question: Which content-delivery feature enables a user to send messages to employees that encourage them to complete their assigned surveys, track survey completion, and invite them to a meeting where the survey results will be shared?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Campaigns support targeted, multichannel, staged employee communications and campaign effectiveness tracking. They can sequence survey-completion reminders with follow-up communications, including an invitation to a meeting to share results.

**Learn more:** [Creating campaigns](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/ecpro-campaigns.html) · [Campaign overview and Campaign analytics dashboards](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/ecpro-content-automation-content-pack.html)

questions.question: Which role is required, at a minimum, to view confidential HR Profile data?
questions.explanation:
Confidential HR Profile information requires a role that includes `sn_hr_core.profile_reader` or `sn_hr_core.profile_writer`. HR Basic (`sn_hr_core.basic`) includes the HR Profile Writer role, providing the required access without requiring the broader HR Admin or HR Manager roles.

**Learn more:** [HR profile and HR case security](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_HRProfileSecurity.html?contentId=Ni_gxAedPsyS3O3qKzwEVQ) · [Components installed with Employee Document Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/employee-service-management/employee-document-management/installed-w-employee-doc-mngemnt.html?contentId=t9c52fagQCpgZXulmDKYHA)

questions.question: What occurs when a cross-scope attempt is executed?

options.label: A
options.text: The record is automatically added to the Restricted Caller Access Privileges table

options.label: B
options.text: The record is automatically set to caller tracking

options.label: C
options.text: The Read record status is set to requested before the system will allow the script to run

options.label: D
options.text: The record status is automatically set to allowed

questions.explanation:
A cross-scope script attempt causes ServiceNow to create a Restricted Caller Access record to track the access request. The record can subsequently be allowed or denied; it is not automatically allowed or converted to caller tracking.

**Learn more:** [Restricted caller access privilege settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/restricted-caller-access-privilege.html)

questions.question: If the Audience field is configured on a Lifecycle Event Activity, what does the system do when the subject person does not meet that Activity’s criteria?

options.label: A
options.text: the activity must be manually closed by the HR professional

options.label: B
options.text: the Lifecycle Event will be canceled

options.label: C
options.text: the activity must be manually closed by the Subject person

questions.explanation:
An audience record controls whether a Lifecycle Event activity triggers for the subject person. When the person does not meet the configured audience criteria during evaluation, the corresponding activity set is set to **Skipped**.

**Learn more:** [Configure the supporting components for a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-supporting-components-for-lifecycle-event.html)

questions.question: How many User Criteria Records can be applied to one KB or KB Article?
questions.explanation:
A knowledge base or knowledge article can be associated with multiple User Criteria records to control access. ServiceNow’s Knowledge Management procedures allow administrators to add the required criteria, including multiple existing criteria, and do not specify a fixed maximum.

**Learn more:** [Control access at the knowledge base level through user criteria](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/t_SelectUserCriteria.html) · [Control access at the knowledge article level through user criteria](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/t_SelectUCArticle.html)

questions.question: What are some benefits of maintaining separate COE tables? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: Allows HR case agents to create database views.

options.label: B
options.text: Allows an extra layer of security within the HR organization.

options.label: C
options.text: Allows HR agents to select a journey.

options.label: D
options.text: Allows HR case agents to gather information based on the Service.

questions.explanation:
Separate HR COE tables support COE-specific access control, allowing HR groups to restrict access to cases in sensitive functional areas. They also allow case records to capture information appropriate to the HR service and functional discipline. ServiceNow documents that COE security policies control read and write access to cases under a specific COE, and that COEs can be configured for their unique functions.

**Learn more:** [HR Centers of Excellence data model](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-centers-of-excellence-coes.html) · [Configure COE security policies](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-coe-security-policies.html)

questions.question: If you have little coding experience and are assigned to add new pages to the customer’s Employee Service Center, which Service Portal Configuration option is best for completing the task?
questions.explanation:
Service Portal Designer is intended for users with little to no coding experience to create or edit portal pages. It supports adding a new page and visually organizing layouts and widgets without requiring widget scripting.

**Learn more:** [Create and edit a page using the Service Portal Designer](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/service-portal/t_ConfigureAPage.html)

questions.question: Where does the HR Administrator configure which HR Profile fields are editable in the ServiceNow instance?
questions.explanation:
The editable HR Profile fields are controlled by the `sn_hr_core.hr_profile_editable_fields` system-property allow list, located at **HR Administration > Properties**.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Add or modify an HR profile](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/baBFTRuHLgu7HSwp0SUEQQ/qkK2qcxKB0xfBY1AxehjIw)

questions.question: Which application lets managers review team members’ development plans and track their progress?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Manager Hub includes a Growth plans page where managers can review their team members’ development plans and track their progress.

**Learn more:** [Combined Manager Hub release notes for upgrades from Vancouver to Yokohama](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/delta-vancouver-yokohama/yokohama-vancouver-managerhub-release-notes.html?contentId=eUs1yLrAH899uQwWt30vYw)

questions.question: Which application provides employees with an omni-channel learning experience, enabling timely access to the right learning?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Learning Posts delivers an omni-channel learning experience that gives employees relevant learning opportunities when they need them.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Learning Posts documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/learning-post-app.html)

questions.question: Which types of HR Document templates can be created in ServiceNow? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow supports two HR Document Template types: Document templates (HTML) and PDF document templates. Both can generate PDF documents, but they are created and maintained differently.

**Learn more:** [HR document templates](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/H8yQl2SqBqnT6LbpTm28UQ/eBzEWdZf2fQ6nkDXLiV6bA)

questions.question: Following an HRSD implementation, which capabilities apply to a System Administrator who attempts to impersonate an HR member after the HR Admin role has been removed? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: System Admin can grant scoped HR roles.

options.label: B
options.text: System Admin can view HR Cases and confidential profile information.

options.label: C
options.text: System Admin cannot grant scoped HR roles.

options.label: D
options.text: System Admin cannot view HR Cases and confidential profile information.

questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, only the HR Administrator (`sn_hr_core.admin`) can assign scoped HR roles. Removing that role from the System Administrator prevents the administrator from gaining protected HR capabilities through impersonation; sensitive HR case details and confidential HR profile information remain restricted to authorized HR roles.

**Learn more:** [Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html) · [HR profile and HR case security](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_HRProfileSecurity.html)

questions.question: What does ServiceNow currently call its HR application?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow names its HR application **HR Service Delivery (HRSD)**, a suite of applications for delivering employee HR services and experiences.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow HR Service Delivery documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-delivery.html)

questions.question: What happens when a parent HR case associated with an HTML document template is cancelled?

options.label: A
options.text: A copy of parent task will be created

options.label: B
options.text: Document task will be still active

options.label: C
options.text: Parent HR case cannot be cancelled

questions.explanation:
Cancelling an HR case automatically cancels its associated document tasks, including tasks generated for an HTML document template.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Document tasks generation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/task-mapped-participants.html)

questions.question: ServiceNow has identified three maturity levels for an HR customer. What are they?
questions.explanation:
The HR Service Delivery transformation journey progresses through Managed Interactions, Self-Reliance, and Smart Services. These stages move from managed HR case and knowledge interactions, through employee self-service, to more intelligent and automated HR service delivery.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow HR Service Delivery Transformation Journey](https://www.servicenow.com/community/s/cgfwn76974/attachments/cgfwn76974/snug-de-germany-tkb-board/36/1/ServiceNow_PHS%20Roundtable_Consumerize%20the%20Employee%20Experience_MKoopmann-compressed.pdf)

questions.question: What benefits result from removing the HR Admin role from the System Admin role once the HR Implementation tasks are complete? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: Confidential HR data is only accessible to users with an HR role

options.label: B
options.text: HR has control over further HR configurations

options.label: C
options.text: System Admin can still grant scoped HR roles

options.label: D
options.text: System admin can view HR Cases and confidential profile information

questions.explanation: Separating the HR Admin role from the System Admin role restricts confidential HR data to users who hold an HR role and gives HR responsibility for subsequent HR configurations.

questions.question: What does an employee use to submit a self-service request to the HR Organization?
questions.explanation:
The HR Catalog provides the employee-facing HR services and catalog items that employees can request directly through a self-service portal. HR templates support record population, HR skills relate to agent capabilities, and HR profiles hold employee-related information.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR service catalog management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-catalog-management.html)

questions.question: For which employment types does the HR Profile table track information? (select 3)
questions.explanation: ServiceNow HR Profile records track HR data for active worker populations, including full-time employees, temporary employees, and contractors. Potential employees and spouses are not worker employment types represented by these HR Profile records, and “Other” is not one of the specified employment types.

questions.question: If the customer uses Predictive Intelligence but does not want the predictive model to automatically determine the correct HR Service for a case, which system property must be disabled?
questions.explanation:
The `sn_hr_core.case_auto_categorization` system property controls Predictive Intelligence–based automatic HR Service determination for HR cases. Disabling it prevents the predictive model from automatically categorizing a case to an HR Service.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Auto determination of HR service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/predict-hr-service.html)

questions.question:
The HR Admin [sn_hr_core.admin] role lets a user add members to groups.

Which additional role does an HR Admin need to remove users from groups?
questions.explanation: The HR User Admin [hr_user_admin] role provides the additional HR-specific user-administration permission needed to remove users from group memberships; HR Admin [sn_hr_core.admin] alone permits adding members but does not grant that removal capability.

questions.question: What distinguishes configuration from customization?

options.label: A
options.text: Configuration uses complex JavaScript while Customization involves field name changes and new buttons.

options.label: B
options.text: There is no difference between Configuration and Customization.

options.label: C
options.text: Customization uses the built-in tools in the platform while Configuration involves code changes.

options.label: D
options.text: Configuration uses the built-in tools in the platform while Customization involves code changes.

questions.explanation: Configuration uses a platform’s built-in declarative tools, while customization involves modifying behavior through code changes.

questions.question: With the I18N: Knowledge Management Internationalization Plugin v2 enabled, how are translated Knowledge articles linked to one another so that users see the article in their selected language?
questions.explanation:
The **Translated Versions** related list links Knowledge articles that share the same parent article. The Parent field tracks translations, enabling the language-specific article relationship. [ServiceNow documentation: Activate the knowledge management internationalization plugin](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/c_ActKMIntPlugin.html)

**Learn more:** [Activate the knowledge management internationalization plugin](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/c_ActKMIntPlugin.html)

questions.question: Which HRSD application automates and simplifies employee onboarding and other activities that span departments?
questions.explanation:
Lifecycle Events automates employee lifecycle processes such as new-hire onboarding and coordinates the associated activities across departments through a single service-delivery platform.

**Learn more:** [Lifecycle events for enterprise](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-journey-management/enterprise-onboarding-transitions-landing-page.html) · [Understanding Lifecycle events for enterprise](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-journey-management/understanding-enterprise-onboarding-and-transitions.html)

questions.question: The HR Integrations application functions much like any other integration in the ServiceNow platform; however, its application scope permits only users with the appropriate HR roles to access its information. In which Application Scope is HR Integrations?
questions.explanation: HR Integrations is contained in the **Human Resources: Integrations** application scope, which restricts access to users assigned the appropriate HR roles.

questions.question: What are the principal components of the HR Service Catalog? (select 4)
questions.explanation:
An HR service intended for employee self-service uses an HR service, an HR catalog item (also called a record producer), and an HR case template. Creating an HR catalog item creates corresponding HR service, record producer, and HR case template records. An assignment group is a configuration attribute rather than a catalog component, and a matching rule is unrelated to this core catalog structure.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create an HR catalog item](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/SogDT~k7ktsbe1ZYegnaLg/nei9EGS~uNm4TFx_kDEe0Q) · [ServiceNow: HR services](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-administration.html)

questions.question: How can an HR Administrator or Content Writer restrict which employees can view content in the Employee Service Center?

options.label: A
options.text: All employees will see the same information

options.label: B
options.text: Client roles automatically limit what is visible to employees

questions.explanation: User Criteria restrict Employee Service Center content visibility to defined groups of employees.

questions.question:
A customer that uses Lifecycle Events Enterprise has documented a large offboarding Lifecycle Event with many steps. Many of these steps, including approvals, must be completed in a particular order.

Which method is best for ensuring that the activities are triggered in the required order?

options.label: A
options.text: Create a new lifecycle event for each of the dependent items

options.label: B
options.text: Create separate trigger conditions for each of the dependent activities

options.label: C
options.text: Create activity containers for the dependent items

options.label: D
options.text: Create separate activity sets for each of the dependent activities

questions.explanation:
An activity container manages dependencies among activities within an activity set. It can order activities sequentially or in parallel, so it supports prerequisite steps and approvals before dependent activities are triggered.

**Learn more:** [Configure a lifecycle event activity](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-hr-lifecycle-event-activity.html?contentId=Tu969_D4ZveO1238TOIUSQ)

questions.question: Each HR service created in _______ has an associated transform map job.
questions.explanation: Each HR service created in HR Integration Service has a corresponding transform map job for processing its integration data.

questions.question: What is the role of Activity Field Mapping?

options.label: A
options.text: To create cases, requests, or tasks that are needed to fulfill a Lifecycle Events case

options.label: B
options.text: To manage the dependencies of activities within an activity set

options.label: C
options.text: It defines the relationships between fields in various tables

options.label: D
options.text: It allows Lifecycle Event Activities to be triggered only for those who meet certain conditions

questions.explanation:
Activity Field Mapping maps values between source and target fields, such as from a parent Lifecycle Event case to fields or variables on a generated child activity. It therefore defines relationships between fields in different tables.

**Learn more:** [Configure a lifecycle event activity](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-hr-lifecycle-event-activity.html?contentId=Tu969_D4ZveO1238TOIUSQ)

questions.question: What is the purpose of Lifecycle Events for Enterprise?

options.label: B
options.text: To manage employee payroll and benefits

options.label: C
options.text: To track employee attendance and time off

options.label: D
options.text: To provide a platform for employees to communicate with each other

questions.explanation:
Lifecycle Events for Enterprise coordinates and automates employee lifecycle work across multiple departments and systems, such as HR, IT, and Facilities.

**Learn more:** [Understanding Lifecycle Events for Enterprise](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-journey-management/understanding-enterprise-onboarding-and-transitions.html)

questions.question: Because Employee Relations (ER) cases are sensitive, stricter security is expected to safeguard privacy. Which of the following features does the scoped version of Employee Relations provide? **(select 2)**

options.label: A
options.text: You can create related records for allegations, interviews, and corrective actions

options.label: B
options.text: Employee Relations cases may only be assigned to agents with the HR Admin role

options.label: C
options.text: Visibility of Employee Relations cases is restricted to upper management

options.label: D
options.text: You can create ER cases without an Opened for or Subject person

questions.explanation:
Scoped Employee Relations supports related investigation records, including allegations, interviews, and corrective actions. It also permits ER cases to be created without an **Opened for** or **Subject person**, which supports anonymous or external reporting. Access is governed through roles, groups, and assignment rules rather than being limited exclusively to HR Admins or upper management.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Employee Relations cases](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-case-employee-relations.html?contentId=5WcRFEtEkARVY4XxpjNzZQ)

questions.question: Which feature enables a user to configure a link that routes to an employee's LinkedIn profile page?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow HR Service Delivery’s Link Generator creates deep links from HR forms to external sites, including social media, and can route directly to profile information in a third-party application.

**Learn more:** [Link generator for HR Service Delivery](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/HRLinkGenerator.html?contentId=9gAa7BKg3Jj~2fhSX7LWfA)

questions.question: Which HR role is generally assigned, at a minimum, to all HR Support staff?
questions.explanation: The **HR Basic** role (`sn_hr_core.basic`) provides the baseline access intended for HR Support staff. The other roles grant specialized authoring, document-management, or administrative capabilities.

questions.question: When an employee contacts HR, they describe events in terms of their lifecycle. From an HR viewpoint, that event is translated into several HR services that must be completed. Which of the following would be considered a lifecycle event?
questions.explanation: Having a baby is a significant employee life change that can trigger multiple HR services, such as benefits changes, dependent enrollment, and parental leave. Direct deposit setup, a PTO inquiry, and tuition reimbursement are individual services or requests rather than lifecycle events.

questions.question: Which ServiceNow feature is used for creating pulse surveys?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Listening Posts enables the creation of simple pulse surveys to capture employee feedback and insights.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Listening Posts documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/employee-service-management/listening-posts/listening-posts.html?contentId=OV5s9Gz3_KDmY2HhGIXhhA)

questions.question: Which feature lets HR Administrators define when surveys are sent?
questions.explanation:
Trigger Conditions define the criteria and events that initiate a survey, such as sending it when an HR task reaches a specified state. They therefore control when the survey is delivered.

**Learn more:** [Automatically initiate a pulse survey from Listening Posts](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/listening-posts/auto-initiate-cnd.html?contentId=WAdFTYHtGw0I14x4mU4h_w)

questions.question: In the **Create Bulk Cases** module, which **Filter by** options are available from the dropdown? *(select 4)*
questions.explanation:
The documented bulk-case filters include Upload file, User criteria, HR profiles, and HR criteria. Upload File, User Criteria, and HR Profiles are present in the supplied choices; HR Criteria—the needed fourth option—is missing. Document and HR-service templates are not Filter by options.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create a user segment group](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/ja-JP/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/bulk-case-segment.html)

questions.question: If you hold both the Admin [admin] and HR Admin [sn_hr_core.admin] roles and want to configure an Access Control Rule for the HR Payroll table, what must be done first?

options.label: A
options.text: Manually add the Delegated Developer role to your User record

options.label: B
options.text: Manually add the security_admin role to your User record

options.label: C
options.text: From the User dropdown in the banner, elevate your role to delegated_developer

options.label: D
options.text: From the User dropdown in the banner, elevate your role to security_admin

questions.explanation:
Access Control Rules require the elevated `security_admin` privilege. Elevated privileges are not active by default at sign-in, so a user who has the necessary administrative roles must elevate to `security_admin` from the user menu for the current session. [ServiceNow: Elevated privilege roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-security/c_ElevatedPrivilege.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Elevated privilege roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-security/c_ElevatedPrivilege.html) · [ServiceNow: Add field security in HR](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/FieldSecurity.html)

questions.question: Which table is regarded as the core table for all HR Case records?
questions.explanation:
The HR Case table, `sn_hr_core_case`, is the base table for HR case records. ServiceNow documents that each HR Center of Excellence extends the HR Case table, making it the common core for HR case data.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR services](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-administration.html)

questions.question: How does ServiceNow determine which HR Template to use for an HR Case?

options.label: A
options.text: The HR Template is referenced on the HR Service record.

options.label: B
options.text: The HR Template is referenced on the record producer form.

options.label: C
options.text: Each COE has a specific HR Template.

options.label: D
options.text: The HR Template is selected directly on the Catalog item.

questions.explanation:
An HR Service record contains the HR case template to use. When a request creates an HR case for that service, ServiceNow uses that configured template to populate the case fields.

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-service.html) · [HR templates](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-template-configuration.html)

questions.question: If you wanted a person to administer the Employee Service Center without assigning them the HR Admin role, which scoped Admin role would they require?
questions.explanation:
The `sn_hr_sp.admin` role is the scoped administrator role for the HR Service Portal application, which provides the Employee Center Core portal framework. It is included in the Employee Center administrative role set; widget, employee-file, and integration administration do not grant general Employee Service Center administration.

**Learn more:** [Employee Center roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/emp-center-personas.html) · [Employee Center plugins](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/install-plugins.html)

questions.question:
When a Document Template is created from an HR Case, the name of the person who created the document is appended to the attachment name.

Why?

options.label: A
options.text: It indicates who should sign the document

options.label: B
options.text: It indicates who generated the document

options.label: C
options.text: It indicates the Opened for user

options.label: D
options.text: It indicates who the document is about

questions.explanation: The attachment name includes the document creator’s name to identify who generated the document from the template.

questions.question: After configuring a Lifecycle Event, what further configuration is required to start the LE process for an employee?

options.label: A
options.text: None. The LE will automatically trigger based on its configuration

options.label: B
options.text: An Event is needed to initiate the LE process

options.label: C
options.text: A Scheduled Job is needed to initiate the LE process

options.label: D
options.text: An HR Service is needed to initiate the LE process

questions.explanation:
A Lifecycle Event must have a corresponding HR service so it can be requested. The HR service creates the lifecycle-event case, and creation of that case starts the workflow that drives the lifecycle-event process.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Building a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/hr-lifecycle-event-configuration.html) · [ServiceNow: Lifecycle Events workflows](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/LEWorkflow.html)

questions.question: What provides a graphical interface for creating survey categories and questions, configuring the details, and publishing the survey?
questions.explanation: Survey Designer is the graphical interface for defining survey categories and questions, configuring survey details, and publishing surveys.

questions.question: If the HR Administrator has been granted only the HR Admin `[sn_hr_core.admin]` role, which additional role is required to configure every aspect of the Employee Document Management application?
questions.explanation:
The EF Admin (`sn_hr_ef.admin`) role has full control of Employee Document Management, including administrative management, role assignment, application properties, and bulk-import configuration. Reader and Writer roles provide document access rather than complete application configuration.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Components installed with Employee Document Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-document-management/installed-w-employee-doc-mngemnt.html?contentId=5jmSsQWEe_Fi0uRLyvcL~w)

questions.question: What occurs when audience criteria are defined both at the activity level and at the activity-set level?

options.label: A
options.text: The audience criteria will be applicable for both the activity set and an activity.

options.label: B
options.text: The audience criteria will reset to empty in the activity and activity set.

options.label: C
options.text: The audience criteria for an activity overrides the audience criteria for an activity set.

options.label: D
options.text: The audience criteria for an activity set overrides the audience criteria for an activity.

questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Lifecycle Events, audience criteria defined for an activity set take precedence over audience criteria defined for an individual activity; the activity-set audience overrides the activity-level audience.

**Learn more:** [Configure a lifecycle event activity set](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/baBFTRuHLgu7HSwp0SUEQQ/UzkKNMV2g9O~DP1vQInuDA)

questions.question: Which HR role is generally assigned to all HR Support staff?
questions.explanation:
The HR Basic role (`sn_hr_core.basic`) is the standard HR agent role and grants the basic access needed for an HR agent’s daily work. HR KB Writer, HR Admin, and HR Case Reader provide specialized or elevated capabilities rather than the typical baseline HR Support role.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Components installed with Case and Knowledge Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/components-installed-with-case-and-knowledge-management.html)

questions.question: When configuring the Onboarding Lifecycle Event, the HR Admin did not choose an Audience for the **Select a Desk** task. If a remote employee is being onboarded, how does the system handle this task?

options.label: A
options.text: The Lifecycle Event rescind process will be triggered

options.label: C
options.text: The Lifecycle Event will be canceled

options.label: D
options.text: The activity will be triggered and must be manually closed

questions.explanation:
A Lifecycle Event activity with no associated Audience record triggers for all employees. The **Select a Desk** activity therefore triggers for a remote employee and must be manually closed when it is not applicable.

**Learn more:** [Configure the supporting components for a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-supporting-components-for-lifecycle-event.html?contentId=4YGWxxqL3fJLM0yufhTf~g)

questions.question: Which minimum role is needed to access the HR Properties module?
questions.explanation:
The HR Properties module requires the HR Administrator role, `sn_hr_core.admin`, which grants access to HR Administration and HR configuration properties.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR properties](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/SogDT~k7ktsbe1ZYegnaLg/HAeCt96sW297ctXsfz3I_Q)

questions.question: Which types of records can HR Service Activities create? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
HR Service Activities can be configured as Approval, Task, or Child HR Service activities. Therefore, the applicable record types are approvals and tasks; workflows are a separate fulfillment option, and HR Templates are not a service-activity type.

**Learn more:** [Configure a service activity for an HR service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-service-activity-for-hr-service.html)

questions.question: To change your application scope to the Employee Center portal, which of the following should you select?
questions.explanation: The Employee Center portal is managed in the Employee Center Core application scope, which exposes its related configuration and development resources.

questions.question: With the Lifecycle Event Enterprise application, tasks can be assigned only to which recipients? (Choose the most appropriate answer.)

options.label: A
options.text: Only users with a Client Role

options.label: B
options.text: Only users with an HR role

options.label: C
options.text: HR Case Workers. Employees, users in other groups

options.label: D
options.text: Only users with the Manager role

questions.explanation: Lifecycle Event Enterprise supports assigning tasks to HR Case Workers, employees, and users in other groups, allowing work to be routed to the people or teams responsible for completing it.
