questions.question: At what point does the HR Template populate information on the HR Case form?

options.label: A
options.text: When the Opened for person is selected

options.label: B
options.text: When the Assignment group is selected.

options.label: C
options.text: When the HR Case Type is selected.

options.label: D
options.text: When the HR service is selected on the HR Case Creation form.

questions.explanation:
An HR template associated with an HR service automatically populates fields on the HR case form when a request for that service is made. In the HR Case Creation form, this occurs when the HR service is selected.

**Learn more:** [HR templates](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-template-configuration.html?contentId=4o0dQ6cjxthiusQdcdm3gA) · [Configure the HR case creation form for an HR service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-case-creation-form-for-hr-service.html)

questions.question: Which Lifecycle Events feature reverses a previously completed activity, such as workplace setup?
questions.explanation:
A Rescind Activity Set cancels and reverts work already completed in a Lifecycle Events case. It can include rescind activities for completed onboarding work, such as workplace setup, so that the appropriate compensating actions can be performed.

**Learn more:** [Configure the rescind process for a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-rescind-for-a-lifecycle-event.html)

questions.question:
Scenario: You have an existing ITSM customer that is now deploying HR Enterprise. During UAT, they found an error stating that a Read operation from the HR scope to the Global scope is denied. You have confirmed that each Script Include was written correctly.

What else must be done to enable the Script Includes to function in the HR application?

options.label: A
options.text: The Status of the associated record on the Application Restricted Caller Access list must be set to Denied.

options.label: B
options.text: You must create a custom ACL to allow the script includes to work.

options.label: C
options.text: The Status of the associated record on the Application Restricted Caller Access list must be set to Allowed.

options.label: D
options.text: You must change Scope for the script includes to work.

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Restricted Caller Access controls cross-scope access to application resources, including Script Includes. A denied HR-to-Global Read request must have its associated Application Restricted Caller Access record approved with a status of **Allowed**; an ACL does not replace this cross-scope privilege.

**Learn more:** [Restricted caller access privilege settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/restricted-caller-access-privilege.html) · [Define cross-scope access to an application resource](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/set-RCA-level.html)

questions.question:
Scenario: An existing ITSM customer is implementing HR Enterprise. As part of that implementation, the Scoped Application Restricted Caller Access [com.glide.scope.access.restricted_caller] plugin was automatically activated.

By default, what is the Caller Access field set to?
questions.explanation:
HR Service Delivery protects sensitive HR scoped tables and Script Include APIs with restricted caller access. Its default Caller Access setting for HR tables is Caller Restriction, so cross-scope calls require explicit approval rather than being automatically allowed and tracked.

**Learn more:** [HR security](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-security.html) · [Restricted caller access privilege settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/restricted-caller-access-privilege.html)

questions.question: When you create a new Lifecycle Event activity set, what occurs if the audience field is left empty?

options.label: A
options.text: The activity set applies to all employees.

options.label: B
options.text: The activity set applies for a specific group of people.

options.label: C
options.text: The activity set will not apply to a specific group of people.

options.label: D
options.text: The activity set will not apply to any employees.

questions.explanation:
An empty Audience field imposes no audience-based restriction, so the Lifecycle Event activity set applies to all employees.

**Learn more:** [Configure a lifecycle event activity set](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-hr-lifecycle-event-activity-set.html?contentId=RIgEj~7_rS9yzVH6i~9g6Q)

questions.question: Which Application Scope contains the Lifecycle Events table?
questions.explanation: The Lifecycle Events table is part of the dedicated Human Resources: Lifecycle Events scoped application, which separates lifecycle-event functionality from HR Core, integrations, and the HR Service Portal.

questions.question: Which feature prevents employee documents associated with an HR Profile from being edited or purged?
questions.explanation:
A legal hold applied to an HR profile protects its associated employee documents by suspending retention-policy deletion and preventing their purging. ServiceNow documents legal holds as the mechanism for protecting all employee documents associated with an HR profile.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Managing employee documents](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/employee-service-management/employee-document-management/hr-doc-management-admin.html?contentId=5tIgXhOMJKJt2nDtTxXFLg)

questions.question: Which learning task template field lets you create the short description and description in one or more languages?
questions.explanation:
Global descriptions for translations lets administrators provide localized short descriptions and descriptions in multiple activated languages, so HR cases and tasks display those texts in the employee’s preferred language.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Translations for HR cases and tasks](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/etYGEBUVr6RQYKLnfpRuhw/zJtK3y1HTjuSK5iKpU8x3A)

questions.question: Which role is required, at a minimum, to configure an HR integration source?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow HR integration-source configuration requires the `sn_hr_integrations.admin` role, which grants HR Integrations administrative access needed to configure sources and their integration credentials.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Provide source credentials for the Sterling service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-integrations-sources-sterling.html?contentId=sVdj1rSmBmS0Xm2uz1_a3A)

questions.question: Which base-instance application provides the results of current-state metrics?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Reporting presents the current state of instance data. Performance Analytics indicators are designed primarily to track scores and trends over time. Therefore, current-state HR metrics are delivered through HR Dashboards and Reports.

**Learn more:** [Performance Analytics indicators compared to table data](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/now-intelligence/performance-analytics/pa-vs-reporting-pa.html) · [Reporting](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/now-intelligence/reporting/reporting-landing-page.html)

questions.question: At which level is User Criteria configured to control who can read and edit knowledge articles?

options.label: A
options.text: In either the Knowledge Base or Article.

questions.explanation:
Knowledge-base user criteria govern read access and contribute access. Contribute access includes the ability to create, modify, and retire knowledge articles, whereas article-level user criteria govern read access only.

**Learn more:** [Managing access to knowledge bases and knowledge articles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/user-access-knowledge.html)

questions.question: Which application can be paired with the Voluntary Separation Lifecycle Event to streamline the employee offboarding process?
questions.explanation:
Journey Accelerator coordinates structured plans, stages, and tasks for employee journeys, so it can be paired with a Voluntary Separation lifecycle event to manage and streamline offboarding work.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Store release notes](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/store-release-notes/page/release-notes/store/sn-store-release-notes.html)

questions.question: Which role is required to assign all scoped HR roles?
questions.explanation:
Only the HR Administrator role (`sn_hr_core.admin`) can assign scoped HR roles in ServiceNow HR Service Delivery.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html)

questions.question: If the HRSD application is scoped, why is the System Administrator initially able to access all HR applications after the plugin is installed?

options.label: A
options.text: When the HR plugins are installed, the necessary HR roles are added to the Admin role.

options.label: B
options.text: The roles were manually granted by a ServiceNow security user.

options.label: C
options.text: The Admin will always have access to all HR tables and data.

options.label: D
options.text: The roles were manually granted by an HR Admin.

questions.explanation:
Installing an HR scoped plugin adds its scoped administrator role as a child role of the standard System Administrator (`admin`) role. The System Administrator therefore initially inherits the required HR roles and access; the HR Administrator role can later be removed from `admin` to restrict access to sensitive HR information. [Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html)

**Learn more:** [Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html)

questions.question:
The customer being implemented wants to use Now Mobile.

What is the minimum HR SKU they can purchase that includes Now Mobile?

options.label: B
options.text: Now Mobile is a standalone solution

questions.explanation:
Now Mobile for HR Service Delivery is included beginning with the HR Service Delivery Professional SKU. Enterprise includes it as a higher tier, but Professional is the minimum qualifying SKU. The HR Service Delivery mobile plugin provides the HR capabilities in the Now Mobile app and activates the related Now Mobile app plugin.

**Learn more:** [Activate HR Service Delivery for mobile](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/human-resources/task/activate-mobile-employee-experience-for-hr-service-delivery.html)

questions.question: What must be updated or loaded into the Customer's instance before the stories are imported?
questions.explanation:
Products must be loaded first because Agile Development 2.0 stories are associated with a product, and the product is the parent structure that can contain stories, epics, and assignment groups. Backlogs are managed views of stories, while epics and groups are associations that are not required for every story. [Create a story in Agile Development 2.0](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/agile-development/create-a-story.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Create a story in Agile Development 2.0](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/it-business-management/agile-development/create-a-story.html) · [ServiceNow — Related lists for a Product in Agile Development 2.0](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/cVzHwL~N5hQ70Ca9r7fiZg/2EsL42QxR33Dwh~QdzBbvw)

questions.question: How can HR Tasks be designated as optional?

options.label: A
options.text: Set Optional to True on the HR Task Template

options.label: B
options.text: Set Optional to True on the Activity Set

options.label: D
options.text: Set Optional to True on the HR Case form

questions.explanation:
An HR Task Template has an **Optional** setting that marks the HR task as optional when the task is generated.

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR task template](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-task-template.html)

questions.question: HR Administrators can configure a personal version of the HR Case Dashboard by using which of the following buttons? (select 2)
questions.explanation:
The HR Case Dashboard can be customized by adding dashboard content and by changing its column layout. ServiceNow documents the relevant actions as **Add content** and **Change Layout**.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR Dashboards & Reports](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_HRDashboardsReports.html)

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Journey designer?

options.label: A
options.text: It tracks the progress of Lifecycle Events and onboarding cases using the dashboards.

options.label: B
options.text: It passes information from the lifecycle event case to a child case or task

options.label: C
options.text: It manages the dependencies of activities within an activity set.

options.label: D
options.text: It combines Lifecycle Event cases and Journey Accelerator action plans.

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Journey designer unifies Lifecycle Events with Journey Accelerator plans to create and manage employee journeys in one experience.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Journey designer documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/journey-designer/jny-dsgnr-landing-page.html?contentId=ZS07umJHeYOkUHn0O7tOdA) · [Create and configure Journey designer journeys](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/journey-designer/jny-dsgnr-journey-configuration.html)

questions.question: Which module enables administrators to limit access to particular HR Services without creating ACL records?
questions.explanation:
COE Security Configuration creates COE security policies that control group read or write access to all or selected HR services in a Center of Excellence. ServiceNow documents it as an alternative to ACL rules.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR service categorization — Configuring HR Service Delivery COE security policies](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/human-resources/concept/hr-service-categorization.html)

questions.question: Which of the following is the primary factor that determines the implementation timeline?
questions.explanation: Configuration complexity is the main driver of an implementation timeline because it directly determines the amount of design, setup, testing, and validation required.

questions.question: When configuring a PDF Document Template, how are form fields mapped to ServiceNow fields?

options.label: A
options.text: The Document field type on the PDF Template Mappings record

options.label: B
options.text: The Preview value field on the PDF Template Mappings record

options.label: C
options.text: The Mapping field on the PDF Template Mappings record

options.label: D
options.text: The Document field on the PDF Template Mappings record

questions.explanation:
The **Mapping field** selects the ServiceNow field whose value is rendered into the corresponding document field. The document field identifies the fillable field in the PDF, whereas the preview value is only a test value and the document field type describes the control type.

**Learn more:** [Add or modify a PDF template mapping](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/PDFTemplateMapping.html)

questions.question: Which assigned HR Admin role enables the administrator to develop within the HR scoped application without the System Admin role?
questions.explanation:
The Delegated Developer (`delegated_developer`) role, when added to an HR Administrator, permits development and modification of HR application-related objects and application structures without granting the broad System Administrator role.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html) · [ServiceNow: Add Delegated Developer to HR Administrator](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_HRAdminRoles.html)

questions.question: Who can configure a Lifecycle Events Employee request after the product's original implementation is complete?
questions.explanation:
Configuring Lifecycle Events employee requests requires the `sn_hr_le.admin` role (or the broader `admin` role). The Lifecycle Events admin role is therefore authorized to perform this configuration.

**Learn more:** [Configure Lifecycle Events employee requests](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-employee-request.html?contentId=ws1OKnEGS1rfegg4O2~t6Q)

questions.question: Which scoped table extends the Task table and permits access only to users who have approved roles?
questions.explanation:
HR Core Case (`sn_hr_core_case`) is an HR Service Delivery table that extends the Task table. Access to HR cases is controlled through scoped HR roles, preventing users without an appropriate HR scoped role from viewing HR case data.

**Learn more:** [Components installed with Case and Knowledge Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/components-installed-with-case-and-knowledge-management.html) · [Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html)

questions.question: Which configuration determines the knowledge bases searched by the **Knowledge results** section on an HR Case?
questions.explanation:
The knowledge bases searched by a case-form Knowledge results area are controlled by Contextual Search. The search context’s resource configuration can constrain a knowledge search to a specified knowledge base, and the table configuration associates that context with the form’s results area.

**Learn more:** [Configure search resource context properties](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/contextual-search/t_ApplyConfigurationToSearch.html?contentId=UxLATkmAPcu663ugv1aXWQ) · [Configure table for a contextual search](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/contextual-search/t_DefineContextualSearchForForm.html)

questions.question: When the Workflow editor is used for a Lifecycle Event, how does the system determine when to trigger a task or approval?

options.label: B
options.text: The activity set trigger condition determines when it is triggered

options.label: C
options.text: Activities are automatically triggered on specific dates

options.label: D
options.text: The Activity trigger condition determines when it is triggered

questions.explanation:
A Lifecycle Event initiates its associated business process when the configured event occurs. Within that process, the Activity Set trigger condition determines whether the contained task or approval activities are triggered.

**Learn more:** [Lifecycle Events — SailPoint IdentityIQ Documentation](https://documentation.sailpoint.com/identityiq/help/lifecycle_manager/lifecycle_events.html) · [Triggering Workflows — SailPoint IdentityIQ Documentation](https://documentation.sailpoint.com/identityiq_84/help/businessprocesses/wf_triggeringwf.html)

questions.question: When configuring a record in the COE ACL Configuration module, how can you apply the conditions to every HR service for the COE?

options.label: A
options.text: Add a filter condition for each HR service

options.label: B
options.text: Select the Applies to all services box

options.label: C
options.text: Write a new ACL record for each HR service

options.label: D
options.text: Select each HR service using the Services list

questions.explanation:
Selecting **Applies to all services** includes all HR services under the selected COE in the COE security policy. Leaving it unselected exposes the Services field for choosing only particular HR services.

**Learn more:** [HR service categorization — ServiceNow Documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/human-resources/concept/hr-service-categorization.html)

questions.question: Which benefits come from using separate COE tables? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: Allows for an extra layer of security within the HR organization.

options.label: B
options.text: Allows HR case agents to gather the right information based on the Service.

options.label: C
options.text: Eliminates the need for an HR case agent.

options.label: D
options.text: Eliminates the need to create database views.

questions.explanation: Separate HR COE tables can apply COE-specific security controls to sensitive case data and can contain fields that are relevant only to the HR services associated with that COE. This lets HR case agents collect the appropriate service-specific information.

questions.question: If an HR Service must be available to employees through the Employee Service Center, which field must be completed on the HR Service?
questions.explanation:
The **Record producer** field associates the HR service with the HR catalog item used for employee self-service. ServiceNow identifies the record producer as the field used to make an HR service available in the HR service catalog.

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-service.html)

questions.question: Which configuration ensures that an activity set triggered by a date field does not trigger when the date field is empty?

options.label: C
options.text: Add a script to the activity set definition

options.label: D
options.text: Select the ignore empty date box.

questions.explanation:
For a date-triggered Lifecycle Events activity set, selecting **Ignore empty date** prevents the activity set from triggering when its trigger date field has no value.

**Learn more:** [Configure a lifecycle event activity set](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/SogDT~k7ktsbe1ZYegnaLg/3PD7VHJRvjtQU0CEjfbsKw)

questions.question: In Employee Document Management, which of the following statements is accurate regarding legal holds?

options.label: A
options.text: Legal Holds are permanent and cannot be removed

options.label: B
options.text: Legal Holds may be placed on a group of HR profiles

options.label: C
options.text: Legal Holds may be placed on either a Document Type or an individual employee’s HR Profile

options.label: D
options.text: Legal Holds may be manually placed on individual employee documents

questions.explanation: Legal holds can be applied either to a Document Type or to an individual employee’s HR Profile, preserving the applicable employee documents from deletion or disposal while the hold remains in effect.

questions.question: If no user criteria are selected for a knowledge base and its articles, what can a user without a role do?

options.label: C
options.text: can neither read nor contribute articles

questions.explanation:
When no knowledge-base user criteria are selected, all users have read access, while contribution access is limited to users who have roles. A user without a role can therefore read articles but cannot contribute to them.

**Learn more:** [Managing access to knowledge bases and knowledge articles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/user-access-knowledge.html)

questions.question: Which of the following applications is installed along with the Human Resources Scoped App: Core plugin?
questions.explanation:
Human Resources Scoped App: Core provides the foundational HR service-delivery capabilities for documenting, interacting on, and fulfilling employee inquiries and requests, including HR case management. Lifecycle Events, Employee Document Management, and Employee Service Center are separate applications or plugins.

**Learn more:** [Activate Case and Knowledge Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/activate-case-and-knowledge-management-scoped.html?contentId=JrjChWf1hzWqxGranytweQ)

questions.question: How can fields for a particular HR Service be shown on the New Case Creation page?

options.label: A
options.text: HR Service-specific fields cannot be added to the New Case Creation page

options.label: B
options.text: Using the Case Creation Service Configurations

options.label: C
options.text: Using the Case Options field on the HR Service

questions.explanation:
A Case Creation Service Configuration controls the HR case creation form for an individual HR service, including additional fields that agents need to capture before the case is created.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Configure the HR case creation form for an HR service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-case-creation-form-for-hr-service.html?contentId=3nV9sh7cky4mlYyA63rqTA)

questions.question: Which plugin, when paired with HRSD, provides storage space, a filing system, and the functionality to purge and retrieve documents?
questions.explanation:
Employee Document Management provides document storage, filing, retrieval, access controls for sensitive documents, and purge capabilities within HR Service Delivery.

**Learn more:** [Employee Document Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-document-management/hr-employee-doc-management.html)

questions.question: What type of information is contained in the HR Profile?
questions.explanation: An HR Profile stores personal data about an employee. Employee-relations cases, employee skills, and basic account or department attributes are maintained in separate records or profile areas.

questions.question: Which data protocol does all ServiceNow web traffic use to ensure that data is always TLS-encrypted in transit?
questions.explanation:
HTTPS provides HTTP communication protected by TLS. ServiceNow redirects end-user HTTP access to HTTPS and uses TLS to encrypt client-to-server traffic, ensuring encryption while data is in transit.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Infrastructure Security](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-security/platform-encryption/infrastructure-security.html) · [ServiceNow Data Encryption White Paper](https://www.servicenow.com/content/dam/servicenow-assets/public/en-us/doc-type/resource-center/white-paper/wp-data-encryption-with-servicenow.pdf)

questions.question: What are the primary differences between an HR Profile record and a User record? (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: The HR Profile stores the employee's assigned delegates.

options.label: B
options.text: The HR Profile includes group membership information.

options.label: C
options.text: The HR Profile includes employee organizational information like Colleagues.

options.label: D
options.text: The HR Profile stores login credential information.

options.label: E
options.text: The HR Profile may include employee marital status.

options.label: F
options.text: The HR Profile is intended to store confidential employee data that is pertinent for HR.

questions.explanation:
An HR Profile is associated with a User record but stores confidential, HR-relevant employee information. It includes HR-specific fields such as marital status and related organizational information such as colleagues—employees who share the same manager. User records instead support platform identity and access data, including credentials and group membership. [ServiceNow: Add or modify an HR profile](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_CreateOrModifyAUserProfile.html), [ServiceNow: HR Profile](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_HRProfileRecords.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Add or modify an HR profile](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_CreateOrModifyAUserProfile.html) · [ServiceNow — HR Profile](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_HRProfileRecords.html)

questions.question: Which applications are used to configure a journey in Journey Designer?
questions.explanation:
Journey Designer uses Lifecycle Events and Journey Accelerator to create and configure journeys. Lifecycle Events provide lifecycle-event fulfillment, while Journey Accelerator provides plan and task templates; Employee Center is used to access journeys rather than configure them.

**Learn more:** [Configure Journey designer features](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/journey-designer/jny-dsgnr-configuration.html) · [Create and configure Journey designer journeys](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/journey-designer/jny-dsgnr-journey-configuration.html)

questions.question: Which Service Portal configuration option lets you customize the HR Service Portal’s logo, theme, and title?
questions.explanation:
The Branding Editor provides portal branding controls: Quick Setup includes the portal title and header logo, while the Theme Colors tab customizes the portal’s visual theme.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Configure portal branding](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/service-portal/c_BrandingEditor.html)

questions.question: What are the benefits of removing the HR Admin role from the system Admin role once the HR implementation tasks are complete? (select 2)

options.label: A
options.text: This ensures that HR has control over further HR configurations.

options.label: B
options.text: The HR Admin role should remain a part of the system Admin role.

options.label: C
options.text: This ensures that confidential HR data is only accessible to users with an HR role.

options.label: D
options.text: It is not necessary because the system Admin always has access to all HR data.

questions.explanation:
Removing the HR Administrator role from the System Administrator role keeps subsequent HR administration under HR-role users and prevents system administrators from inheriting access to sensitive HR information. ServiceNow documents that HR Administrator users manage HR-scoped roles and that removing the role from System Administrator helps prevent access to sensitive HR data.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html) · [ServiceNow: Remove HR roles from IT Admins](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_HRRemoveAdminRole.html)

questions.question: What identifies HRSD data to send to a third-party HR application?
questions.explanation:
HR Outbound Schema Mapping maps data fields from HRSD source tables to the appropriate fields in the third-party system, defining the data pushed outward.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Verify integration for the First Advantage service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/verify-base-inbound-integration-for-first-advantage.html?contentId=grdL5S2L4i7Z~Pe~gTDy9g)

questions.question: How can a Guided Setup task be reopened after it has been marked as complete?

options.label: B
options.text: Click the Mark as Incomplete button

questions.explanation:
A completed Guided Setup task can be returned to an incomplete state by selecting **Mark as Incomplete**, which reopens the task without restarting the entire Guided Setup.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Docs: Exploring Guided Setup](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/platform-user-interface/adoption-services/exploring-guided-setup.html?contentId=OU7LDXhSQd29als6AHmuUA)

questions.question: What does the HR Properties module allow HR Administrators to do within ServiceNow’s HRSD application?

options.label: C
options.text: Control the overall behavior of the application

questions.explanation: HR Properties provides application-level settings that determine the overall behavior of the HRSD application. Individual HR Services are configured separately.

questions.question:
A customer using Lifecycle Events Enterprise has configured its onboarding process. Management has now assigned the HR Admin the task of creating a way to undo onboarding work if the new employee decides not to join the company.

Which of these is the best method for reversing work already completed as part of this Lifecycle Event?

options.label: A
options.text: Check the “allow blackout” box on each of the activities

options.label: B
options.text: Configure a new Lifecycle Event with the necessary activities

options.label: C
options.text: Configure the rescind activity set with the necessary activities

options.label: D
options.text: Check the “allow blackout” box on each of the activity sets

questions.explanation:
The rescind process is designed to cancel and revert work completed in a Lifecycle Events case, including onboarding work when a new hire does not join the organization. The required reversal actions are configured as rescind activities in the Rescind activity set.

**Learn more:** [Configure the rescind process for a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-rescind-for-a-lifecycle-event.html)

questions.question: In the HR Guided Setup module, which of the following does the Configuration View display for a Category? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
The Guided Setup Configuration View provides configuration workspace elements such as forms, lists, and properties, which let an administrator complete the required setup for a category.

**Learn more:** [ITSM Guided Setup configuration view](https://www.servicenow.com/community/s/cgfwn76974/attachments/cgfwn76974/it-service-management-forum/254880/5/ITSM%20Guided%20SetUp.pdf)

questions.question: Scenario: An existing ITSM customer is deploying Human Resources Scoped App: Core. During UAT, the customer encounters an error stating that a Read operation from the HR scope to the Global scope is denied. Every Script Include is out of the box and unchanged. What must be done to enable the Script Includes to work in the HR application?

options.label: A
options.text: The record must be recommitted with an update set

options.label: B
options.text: The Status of the associated record on the Application Restricted Caller Access list must be set to Allowed

options.label: C
options.text: A custom ACL must be created to allow the Script Includes to work

options.label: D
options.text: The Scope must be changed for the Script Includes to work

questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Restricted Caller Access controls cross-scope requests to application resources, including Script Includes. A denied HR-to-Global read requires approval of the associated restricted caller access record by setting its Status to Allowed.

**Learn more:** [Restricted caller access privilege settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/restricted-caller-access-privilege.html) · [Approve application restricted caller access privileges](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/ur-mst-approve-rca.html)

questions.question: The HR Case [sn_hr_core_case] table extends which table?
questions.explanation:
The HR Case [sn_hr_core_case] table is an extension of the Task [task] table, so it inherits the common task record structure and behavior. ServiceNow’s HR Service Delivery documentation identifies HR tables, including HR Case, as extensions of the Task table.

**Learn more:** [Create or modify an HR Service Delivery response template](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/SogDT~k7ktsbe1ZYegnaLg/ngcm508NiEORL0fG6kNcVw)

questions.question: Starting with the Orlando release, which module enables HR Administrators to specify which groups can access the various COEs or HR Services without having to edit or create new ACL records?
questions.explanation:
COE ACL Configuration uses COE security policies to control group read and write access to HR cases and HR services within a Center of Excellence. It is provided as an alternative to creating or modifying ACL rules.

**Learn more:** [Configure COE security policies](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-coe-security-policies.html)

questions.question: If neither the Knowledge Base nor the KB article has **Can Read** User Criteria, which role is required to read the article?
questions.explanation:
When no user criteria is selected for a knowledge base, all users can read its articles. In the absence of Can Read criteria at both the knowledge base and article levels, reading the article does not require an HR role.

**Learn more:** [Managing access to knowledge bases and knowledge articles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/user-access-knowledge.html)

questions.question: Which module in **HR Integrations** is used to document the URL, core integration properties, and inbound and outbound username and password details for a third-party application?
questions.explanation:
Sources is the HR Integrations module used to maintain a third-party application’s connection details. The source record’s credentials configuration includes the endpoint URL plus inbound and outbound usernames and passwords; it also holds the integration source properties.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Provide source credentials for the First Advantage service](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/ja-JP/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-integrations-sources-first-advantage.html)

questions.question: Which field in the Knowledge form classifies the Knowledge record within the Knowledge base?
questions.explanation:
The Category picker field assigns a Knowledge record to a category in its Knowledge base. Knowledge article categories provide the category structure for each knowledge base.

**Learn more:** [Exploring Knowledge Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/exploring-knowledge-management.html)

questions.question: Who is able to generate the PDF document on an active HR Case?
questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, manual PDF generation for an active HR case is performed by the user assigned to that case. This keeps document creation with the HR agent accountable for handling the case; being the employee, the subject person’s manager, or an HR manager alone does not grant the action.

**Learn more:** [Using Document Templates: HR Service Delivery](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/understanding-doc-templates.html) · [HR document generation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/DocumentGeneration.html)

questions.question: Which generic methodologies form the basis of the ServiceNow SIM methodology?
questions.explanation: ServiceNow Implementation Methodology (SIM) combines Agile practices with Waterfall structure, allowing implementations to use iterative delivery while retaining phased project governance.

questions.question: What determines whether a user can view a Knowledge article?
questions.explanation:
Knowledge article visibility is governed by read access. ServiceNow controls that access through **Can Read** and **Cannot Read** user criteria; contribution criteria control authoring and lifecycle actions rather than ordinary viewing.

**Learn more:** [Managing access to knowledge bases and knowledge articles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/user-access-knowledge.html?contentId=gYAgZq9x~nf3JdDHU4Bz_g) · [Control access at the knowledge article level through user criteria](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/t_SelectUCArticle.html)

questions.question: In which module can an HR administrator manage the HR email address for incoming HR requests?
questions.explanation: The incoming HR-request email address is configured as an HR Service Delivery application property. HR-specific properties are managed in the **HR Administration > Properties** module.

questions.question: While testing a lifecycle event, you deselected specific cards. When you run the test, what happens to the activities that were deselected?

options.label: A
options.text: The activity wit be skipped for all future lifecycle events

options.label: B
options.text: The activity will be created and automatically cancelled for the test

options.label: C
options.text: The activity will be created and must be manually closed for the test

options.label: D
options.text: The activity will be skipped for the test

questions.explanation:
In ServiceNow Lifecycle Events, the test tool allows activities to be included or excluded for an individual test case. A deselected activity is excluded from that test run, so it is not created or processed, and its configuration remains available for future lifecycle event cases.

**Learn more:** [Preview and test a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/test-lifecycle-event.html)

questions.question: Which minimum role is needed to view confidential data associated with the HR Profile?
questions.explanation: The `sn_hr_core.profile_reader` role is the least-privileged role designed to view HR Profile information, including confidential profile data. Broader administrative or general HR roles are not the minimum required role for this access.

questions.question: When working in Agent workspace for Case Management, how can the default maximum Employee Document size of 30MB be modified?

options.label: A
options.text: Using the maximum file upload size in megabytes Security policy

options.label: B
options.text: Using the file upload size system property

options.label: C
options.text: Using the maximum file upload size in megabytes field in the Employee Document Properties

options.label: D
options.text: Using the maximum file upload size business rule

questions.explanation:
The Employee Document Management configuration exposes a **Maximum file upload size in megabytes** field in Employee Document Properties. That field controls the default 30 MB maximum size for Employee Document uploads in Agent Workspace.

**Learn more:** [Create or upload employee documents using Agent Workspace for HR Case Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/hr-agent-ws-create-emp-doc.html?contentId=QHqZ_ND3AGc15BWF3sTrhg)

questions.question: When an employee finishes a questionnaire on an Employee Form, which table stores the employee’s answers?
questions.explanation:
Employee Form questionnaires are built with Survey Designer, so the collected responses are saved in the Metric Result (`asmt_metric_result`) table.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Collect employee input](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/employee-form-configuration.html)

questions.question: What additional action is required to allow the Link to function?

options.label: A
options.text: The Status of the associated record on the Application Restricted Caller Access list must be set to Denied.

options.label: B
options.text: You must create a custom ACL to allow the link to work.

options.label: C
options.text: The Status of the associated record on the Application Restricted Caller Access list must be set to Allowed.

options.label: D
options.text: You must change Scope for the link to work.

questions.explanation:
HR Service Delivery uses Restricted Caller Access to protect cross-scope access to HR resources. When a cross-scope request is restricted, ServiceNow creates an Application Restricted Caller Access record; access is granted only after its Status is set to **Allowed**. [Restricted caller access privilege settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/restricted-caller-access-privilege.html)

**Learn more:** [Restricted caller access privilege settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/restricted-caller-access-privilege.html) · [Define cross-scope access to an application resource](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/set-RCA-level.html)

questions.question: When a new HR Knowledge base is created, how can it be included in the Knowledge results section of the HR Case form?

options.label: A
options.text: Add it to the HR Template

options.label: B
options.text: Add it to the HR Service configuration

options.label: C
options.text: All Knowledge bases are searched by default

options.label: D
options.text: Add it to the Contextual Search configuration

questions.explanation:
The Knowledge results area on an HR Case form is powered by Contextual Search. Its configuration controls the search context and the knowledge resources returned for the form, so adding the new HR Knowledge base to that configuration makes its articles available in the results, subject to user access criteria.

**Learn more:** [Configure table for a contextual search](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/contextual-search/t_DefineContextualSearchForForm.html) · [Contextual search](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/contextual-search/c_ContextualSearch.html)

questions.question: Which functions are performed by a journey template owner? (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: Manage the order and flow of the journey stages and tasks

options.label: B
options.text: Create task templates for their audience in a simple, user-friendly experience

options.label: C
options.text: Add owners and approvers to journey configurations

options.label: D
options.text: Change only the task templates that they own

options.label: E
options.text: Maintain oversight of journey templates and approval flows

questions.explanation: Journey template owners create task templates for their assigned audience, can modify only the task templates they own, and manage the ordering and flow of journey stages and tasks.

questions.question: Which caller-access option is configured by default for HR tables?
questions.explanation:
HR tables use **Caller Restriction** by default to protect sensitive employee data. Cross-scope callers must be explicitly authorized through Restricted Caller Access privileges before they can access those tables.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Security documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/k2ZlVFE9VIfTCBczBNm1IQ/BkvJnY3USCKculpCtbiKQg)

questions.question: Which role is required, at a minimum, to access the Lifecycle Events Cases View Dashboard?
questions.explanation:
The Lifecycle Events Case Reader role (`sn_hr_le.case_reader`) grants read access to Lifecycle Events cases, which is the least-privileged access needed for a dashboard that displays those cases. The Lifecycle Events administrator role includes this role but grants broader administrative permissions.

**Learn more:** [Components installed with Lifecycle Events](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/components-installed-with-enterprise-onboarding-and-transitions.html?contentId=zTtZiSjI29poVOrGELsSJA)

questions.question: When configuring a record in the COE Security Configuration module, how are conditions applied to every HR service?

options.label: A
options.text: Select the 'Applies to all services' box

options.label: B
options.text: Write a new ACL record for each HR service

options.label: C
options.text: Add a filter condition for each HR service

options.label: D
options.text: Select each HR service using the services list

questions.explanation: Enabling the **Applies to all services** option makes the COE security configuration apply across all HR services, rather than limiting it to individually selected services or requiring separate conditions or ACL records.

questions.question: Which plugin is recommended for upgrading from the global version of HR to the scoped version?

options.label: A
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Employee Relations [com.sn_hr_employee_relations]

options.label: B
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Data Migration [com.sn_hr_migration]

options.label: C
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events]

questions.explanation:
Human Resources Scoped App: Data Migration migrates HR tables and roles from the non-scoped HR application to the scoped HR application.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Activate HR Migration](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/activate-hr-migration.html?contentId=6GiVqOYtCMMe0xydm_HbVA)

questions.question: Which feature lets employees delegate their tasks to other employees for specified date and time ranges according to delegation rules?
questions.explanation:
Role Delegation temporarily assigns an eligible role from a delegator to a proxy. During the defined delegation period, the proxy can perform the tasks associated with that role on the relevant data.

**Learn more:** [Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM: Role Delegation](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/human-resources/faqbs/role-delegation.html)

questions.question: If the **Match All** field is selected on a User Criteria record, the user:

options.label: A
options.text: Must satisfy at least one of the criteria to meet the conditions.

options.label: B
options.text: Must satisfy at least of the criteria to meet the conditions.

options.label: C
options.text: Must satisfy a majority percentage of the criteria to meet the conditions.

options.label: D
options.text: Must satisfy all of the selected criteria to meet the conditions.

questions.explanation:
The **Match All** setting requires every populated user-criteria condition to be met. Access is granted only to users who match all selected criteria.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create a user criteria record for Service Portal](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/service-portal/create-user-criteria-record.html)

questions.question: Delegated Developers are granted access only to what they are working in?
questions.explanation:
Delegated development uses application-scoped permissions: a developer is granted permissions for specific applications/scopes, not unrestricted access to an entire instance, its APIs, or its interfaces. Application scope isolates an application’s tables and business logic from other applications unless explicit access is granted.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow — Delegated development and deployment](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/delegated-development-and-deployment/c_DelegatedDevelopment.html) · [ServiceNow — Application scope](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/c_ApplicationScope.html)

questions.question: After the HR Admin [sn_hr_core.admin] role is removed from the Admin role, how can a user who has only the Admin role add members to HR groups?

options.label: A
options.text: The Admin must elevate their role to security_admin to add members to HR groups.

options.label: B
options.text: The Admin follows the same process as with any group membership change.

options.label: C
options.text: The Admin can no longer add members to HR groups.

options.label: D
options.text: The Admin must impersonate an HR Admin to add members to HR groups.

questions.explanation:
Managing HR groups, including adding group members, requires the HR Administrator role [sn_hr_core.admin] together with user_admin. Removing sn_hr_core.admin from the Admin role prevents an Admin-only user from managing HR groups; impersonation does not provide access to features granted by HR scope-protected roles.

**Learn more:** [Manage HR Groups](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/human-resources/task/t_ManageHRGroups.html) · [Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html)

questions.question: At a minimum, which role must a user have to view confidential data on the HR Profiles table?
questions.explanation:
Confidential HR profile information is viewable only by authorized HR personnel whose role includes `sn_hr_core.profile_reader` or `sn_hr_core.profile_writer`. The reader role is the minimum role that provides viewing access; HR case roles govern HR case data rather than HR profile data.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR profile and HR case security](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_HRProfileSecurity.html)

questions.question: What is the function of the **Owning Group** field on the HR Template?

options.label: A
options.text: They approve the Template to be published.

options.label: C
options.text: They manage updates to the Template.

options.label: D
options.text: HR Cases are assigned to the Owning Group.

questions.explanation:
The Owning Group identifies the group responsible for the HR case template and supports that group’s maintenance of the template, including its updates. It does not assign HR cases or control template publication approval. ServiceNow documents the field as the group responsible for the HR case template.

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR case template](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/iMpltWWdX~aXgRlaoFVPCw/8bKFivC8BfMDHRAWe5WyKw)

questions.question: When creating a PDF Document Template, what is the source of the list of Document Revisions?
questions.explanation:
PDF document templates use document revisions from ServiceNow Managed Documents. The Document revision field selects the document and revision on which the template is based, and its available entries originate from Managed Documents.

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR PDF document template](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/PDFTemplate.html)

questions.question: When does the platform assign a Client Role to a user?

options.label: A
options.text: Client Roles must be manually added to each employee record

options.label: B
options.text: When an HR Profile is created or modified for the employee

options.label: C
options.text: Client Roles are automatically added with Group membership

options.label: D
options.text: When a User record is created for the employee

questions.explanation: ServiceNow HR Service Delivery automatically assigns the applicable client role when an employee’s HR Profile is created or modified, using the HR profile information to determine the appropriate access.

questions.question: If the customer has enabled Lifecycle Enterprise, in which Application Scope should they create new Lifecycle Events that assign tasks to teams across their organization?
questions.explanation:
Lifecycle Events that coordinate tasks across organizational teams belong to the Human Resources: Lifecycle Enterprise scoped application. ServiceNow documentation identifies Lifecycle Events as the capability used to configure such events and requires the Human Resources: Lifecycle Enterprise application for related lifecycle-event configuration.

**Learn more:** [Using Lifecycle Events](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/using-lifecycle-events.html) · [Change the evaluation interval default wait time](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/le-activity-set-evaluation-interval.html)

questions.question: What type of records are created by HR Requests?
questions.explanation: HR Requests are used to initiate and track HR service work as HR cases. Each request creates an HR case for the appropriate HR service and fulfillment process.

questions.question: With how many COEs can an HR Service be associated?
questions.explanation:
An HR service is categorized under one HR Center of Excellence (COE). A COE can contain multiple HR services, but each individual service belongs to a single COE.

**Learn more:** [HR service categorization](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-categorization.html)

questions.question: Which feature enables a user to transfer Employee Relocation Approval tasks to another user?
questions.explanation: Granular Delegation lets a user assign specific responsibilities or tasks, including Employee Relocation Approvals, to another user without transferring all of the user’s access or role assignments.

questions.question: Which application lets administrators create templates that allow managers to develop employee transition plans?
questions.explanation:
Journey Accelerator enables administrators to create templates for employee transition plans, including onboarding, offboarding, promotions, and role changes. Managers use those templates to create customized transition plans for employees.

**Learn more:** [Exploring Journey Accelerator](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/journey-accelerator/exploring-jny-accelerator.html?contentId=HessYTVrZNylcu9tv6Egdg)

questions.question: Which actions can HR Agents take in the Agent Workspace for HR Case Management workspace? (select 3)

options.label: A
options.text: View information that is related to the employee or the case

options.label: C
options.text: Create or work on HR cases to completion

options.label: D
options.text: Chat with employees and create or work on their requests

questions.explanation:
Agent Workspace for HR Case Management provides access to information related to HR cases and employees, lets authorized HR case writers view, create, and work on cases, and supports employee interactions through chat, including creating cases or requests from those interactions.

**Learn more:** [Using Agent Workspace for HR Case Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/en-US/bundle/zurich-employee-service-management/page/product/human-resources/concept/agent-ws-hr-case-mgmt-use.html) · [Using interactions in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/agent-workspace-for-hr-case-management/hr-agent-ws-interactions.html?contentId=tzh8J7IVy2JCB4RoghfqJA)

questions.question: Which portal lets employees submit complaints about ethical violations?
questions.explanation: Employee Center is the employee-facing ServiceNow portal through which employees can submit HR-related requests and cases, including ethical-violation complaints.

questions.question: With the I18N: Knowledge Management Internationalization Plugin v2 enabled, how are translated Knowledge articles linked to one another so users are shown the article in their selected language?
questions.explanation:
The plugin installs the **Translated Versions** relationship, which creates a related list of articles sharing the same parent article. The Parent field tracks translations of an article, enabling related language-specific versions to be managed and selected.

**Learn more:** [Activate the knowledge management internationalization plugin](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/c_ActKMIntPlugin.html)

questions.question:
When creating a PDF Document template, you must complete the **Document revision** field.

How does the system decide which documents are available for selection in this field?

options.label: A
options.text: You must be a member of the Owning Group for the Managed Document

options.label: C
options.text: Your group memberships and the Document owner field on the Managed Document record

options.label: D
options.text: You must have created the Managed Document record

questions.explanation:
Available Managed Document revisions are determined by the user’s group memberships together with the **Document owner** field on the Managed Document record.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Configure an HR PDF document template](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/washingtondc/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/PDFTemplate.html)

questions.question: Which role configures the information that is visible in Employee Center Pro?
questions.explanation:
The Service Portal Administrator role (`sp_admin`) provides the portal-administration capability used to configure Employee Center content and presentation. ServiceNow identifies `sp_admin` as a role included with Employee Center administration and notes that it has the scripting rights needed to create widgets and update relevant cross-scope tables.

**Learn more:** [Employee Center Pro roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/ecpro-roles.html)

questions.question: How is an HR template linked to an HR service?

options.label: B
options.text: On the Lifecycle Event Activity Set

questions.explanation:
An HR service record has a **Template** field that specifies the HR case template used when a request for that service creates an HR case. [Configure an HR service — ServiceNow Documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-service.html)

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR service — ServiceNow Documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/configure-hr-service.html)

questions.question: What provides a graphical view of other tables related to a particular table, either by class extension or reference?
questions.explanation:
A ServiceNow Schema Map visually displays a table’s relationships, including tables that reference it, are referenced by it, extend it, or are extended by it.

**Learn more:** [Viewing table references and extensions](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/c_SchemaMapForTables.html)

questions.question: Which role is needed to assign scoped HR roles?
questions.explanation:
Only the HR Administrator role (`sn_hr_core.admin`) is authorized to assign scoped HR roles in ServiceNow HR Service Delivery.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html)

questions.question: As part of implementing an HR Enterprise customer, a new Lifecycle Event for a leave of absence has been created. What additional item must be configured to initiate the leave-of-absence Lifecycle Event process for an employee?

options.label: C
options.text: An acceptance from an HR Agent

questions.explanation:
An HR service is the entry point for HR case creation and must be configured with the Lifecycle Event fulfillment type and the applicable Lifecycle Event type. That association allows the leave-of-absence service request to create an HR case fulfilled by the Lifecycle Event.

**Learn more:** [Configure an HR service for a lifecycle event](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/create-hr-service-for-lifecycle-event.html)

questions.question: Which of the following predefined Dashboards are installed with HR Case Management? (select 3)
questions.explanation:
HR Case Management includes the predefined Overview, Manager Dashboard, and HR Case Dashboard in HR Dashboards & Reports. These dashboards provide operational views of HR case information for HR users and managers.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow HR Dashboards & Reports](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_HRDashboardsReports.html)

questions.question: Within the base ServiceNow instance, how are User Criteria used?

options.label: A
options.text: To control which users can access the HR Case application

options.label: B
options.text: To control what a user sees in the information and suggested reading widgets

options.label: C
options.text: To control read and write access to Knowledge bases and articles

options.label: D
options.text: To control which users can access the HR Service Portal

questions.explanation:
User Criteria assigned to a knowledge base control which users can read its articles and which users can contribute to them, providing the relevant read and write access control.

**Learn more:** [Control access at the knowledge base level through user criteria](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/t_SelectUserCriteria.html)

questions.question: Which feature lets rules replace text blocks in an HR document while avoiding the creation of multiple template versions?
questions.explanation:
Document Blocks provide reusable content within HR document templates, allowing rule-driven text variations to be managed in one template instead of maintaining separate template versions. ServiceNow documents that document blocks can be used across multiple HTML templates.

**Learn more:** [Create document blocks in Document Templates](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/create-doc-blc.html)

questions.question: Which module offers a user-friendly interface to create new HR Skills and assign HR skills to members of the HR department?
questions.explanation:
The **Manage HR Skills** module lets administrators create or edit HR skills and assign them to HR users, supporting HR case and task auto-assignment.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Assign an HR skill to a user](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_AssignHRSkillsToUsers.html) · [ServiceNow: Add or modify an HR skill](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_CreateOrModifyHRSkills.html)

questions.question: User authentication and instance restriction are examples of which type of security?
questions.explanation: Platform access security governs entry to the ServiceNow platform, including user authentication and restrictions on access to a particular instance. Roles and groups authorize capabilities after access is established, while contextual security controls access based on record-related context.

questions.question:
The customer being implemented has purchased HR Service Delivery Enterprise, which includes Enterprise Onboarding and Transitions.

Which plugin must be activated to use Enterprise Onboarding and Transitions?

options.label: A
options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events]

questions.explanation:
Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events (`com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events`) enables configuration and management of HR lifecycle-event workflows, including onboarding and transitions. Its activation installs the related lifecycle-event components and activates the Core and Employee Center dependencies as needed.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Activate Lifecycle Events](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/activate-enterprise-onboarding-and-transitions-scoped.html) · [ServiceNow: Components installed with Lifecycle Events](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/components-installed-with-enterprise-onboarding-and-transitions.html?contentId=zTtZiSjI29poVOrGELsSJA)

questions.question: In the HR Guided Setup module, why are certain tasks locked in the Task view?

options.label: A
options.text: They require an elevated role to access.

options.label: B
options.text: They are deprecated tasks that should not be completed.

options.label: C
options.text: They require other tasks to be completed first.

options.label: D
options.text: They require a plugin to be activated first.

questions.explanation:
Certain HR Guided Setup tasks depend on an associated plugin or feature being activated. They remain locked until that activation requirement is satisfied.

**Learn more:** [Guided setup for HR Service Delivery](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/guided-set-up-hr.html) · [Exploring Guided Setup](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/platform-user-interface/adoption-services/exploring-guided-setup.html?contentId=OU7LDXhSQd29als6AHmuUA)

questions.question: What is Journey designer used for?

options.label: A
options.text: It tracks the progress of Lifecycle Events and onboarding cases using the dashboards.

options.label: B
options.text: It creates templates for plan and to-do tasks that managers, employees, and mentors can access.

options.label: C
options.text: It manages the dependencies of activities within an activity set.

options.label: D
options.text: It combines Lifecycle Event cases and Journey Accelerator action plans.

questions.explanation:
Journey designer provides a unified journey configuration that can include both a Lifecycle Event and a Journey Accelerator plan, combining case-based lifecycle work with action-plan content.

**Learn more:** [Journey designer Journey Configuration fields reference](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/journey-designer/jny-dsgnr-jrny-config-fields.html?contentId=fCtjKv_BJFmFC_D6LVkfvQ) · [Configure Journey designer features](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/journey-designer/jny-dsgnr-configuration.html)

questions.question:
If no Case options are specified for the HR Service, HR Documents must be generated manually for the HR Case.

In this situation, who can generate an HR document for the Case?
questions.explanation: Any HR professional with access to the HR case can manually generate an HR document when the associated HR Service has no Case options specified. The capability is not limited to an HR Admin, HR Manager, or the assigned-to user.

questions.question: The Lifecycle Events [sn_hr_le_case] table directly extends which table?
questions.explanation:
The HR Lifecycle Events Case table (`sn_hr_le_case`) extends the HR Case table (`sn_hr_core_case`), inheriting its case data model and adding lifecycle-events-specific fields and behavior.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Components installed with Lifecycle Events](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/components-installed-with-enterprise-onboarding-and-transitions.html?contentId=zTtZiSjI29poVOrGELsSJA)

questions.question: What role do journey administrators have in creating journey templates?

options.label: A
options.text: Journey Administrators are responsible for manually assigning tasks to employees within the journey templates.

options.label: B
options.text: Journey Administrators are responsible for providing feedback on the journey templates created by managers.

options.label: C
options.text: Journey Administrators are responsible for approving the journey templates created by managers.

options.label: D
options.text: Journey Administrators are responsible for creating the journey templates for plans and to-do tasks.

questions.explanation:
Journey administrators create and configure journey templates, including the plans and to-do tasks that compose a journey. Oracle’s Journeys documentation describes creating journeys through Journey Templates and adding their associated tasks.

**Learn more:** [Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM: How You Create Journeys](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/human-resources/faijh/how-you-create-journeys.html) · [Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM: How Do I Create Journey Tasks?](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/human-resources/fajqa/how-do-i-create-journey-tasks.html)

questions.question: If an HR Service is to be used only internally by HR professionals, what is the minimum required configuration?

options.label: B
options.text: HR Service, HR Template, and Record Producer.

options.label: D
options.text: HR Service, HR Template, Record Producer, and Lifecycle event type.

questions.explanation:
An internally used HR service requires configuration of the HR service and an HR case template. A record producer is needed only for employee self-service through the HR service catalog; a lifecycle event type is not required for this internal-only configuration.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR services](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-administration.html)

questions.question: If the HR Admin [sn_hr_core.admin] must develop in the HR application but cannot be granted the System Admin role, which additional role should be assigned?
questions.explanation:
The Delegated Developer [delegated_developer] role, when added to HR Administrator [sn_hr_core.admin], permits modification of HR application-related objects and application structures without granting the System Administrator role.

**Learn more:** [Manage HR roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_ManageRoles.html?contentId=6tOZvhKO95qswP19_HIt3Q)

questions.question: When is the Record producer field required on an HR Service record?

options.label: A
options.text: When the HR professional will be creating Cases on behalf of the employee

options.label: B
options.text: When you want the employee to request the HR Service from the Employee Service Center

options.label: C
options.text: It is always a required field

options.label: D
options.text: There is no Record producer held on the HR Service record

questions.explanation:
An HR service needs a record producer when employees must be able to request that service through the self-service HR catalog, such as from the Employee Service Center. The record producer supplies the employee-facing catalog item that creates the HR case.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR services](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-administration.html)

questions.question: In the base instance, what determines the conditions that a Case must satisfy before it can be assigned to an agent?
questions.explanation:
Matching rules define the case-attribute conditions that must be met before a case is routed to an agent. Assignment rules then use a matching rule to route qualifying cases to users or groups.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Route and assign cases](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/customer-service-management/c_CaseRouting.html)

questions.question:
On the HR Case form, certain HR Services have related Response templates.

What determines which HR Services have Response Templates?

options.label: A
options.text: The HR Criteria on the HR Service

options.label: B
options.text: The HR Criteria on the Response Template record

options.label: C
options.text: The table and conditions on the Response Template record

options.label: D
options.text: The User Criteria on the HR Service

questions.explanation:
A Response Template is tied to a table and can include conditions that must be satisfied before it is available. For HR cases, those conditions can filter by the HR service, thereby determining which HR Services display the template.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Response templates](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/response-templates-templated-snippets.html)

questions.question: How can users view and search knowledge articles in their own language while still being able to access articles in other languages?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable multi language search through Knowledge Properties

options.label: B
options.text: Enable multi language search through HR Case HR Admin Properties

questions.explanation:
The **Enable multi-language search** Knowledge property enables searches across the available article languages. Knowledge internationalization supports language-specific articles, allowing users to use their own language and access articles in other languages as needed.

**Learn more:** [Knowledge Management properties](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/r_KnowledgeProperties.html?contentId=U_JFjSo12O~CCHvm1kzDOQ) · [I18N - Knowledge internationalization](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/c_I18NKMInternational.html)

questions.question: When using the Generate HR Profiles module to create HR Profiles, which field must be completed to ensure employees are granted the appropriate Client Role?
questions.explanation:
Client-role assignment rules evaluate HR Profile conditions. ServiceNow’s base rules use **Employment type**—with the employment start date where applicable—to automatically assign the appropriate client role.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Client role assignment rules](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/t_ClientRoleAssignRules.html)

questions.question: Which ServiceNow security capability grants access to applications and modules?
questions.explanation:
Roles control access to features and capabilities in ServiceNow applications and modules. Adding a role to an application or module grants that access to users who have the role.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Grant a role access to applications and modules](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/user-administration/t_GrantARoleAccessToAppsAndModules.html)

questions.question: Which copies of existing reports can a user who has only the HR Admin `[sn_hr_core.admin]` role save and modify?
questions.explanation:
The HR Admin role has the reporting permissions needed to save and modify copies of existing reports across personal, group, and global visibility types. ServiceNow reporting supports creating a copied report and saving it with an appropriate visibility state.

**Learn more:** [Copy a report](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/now-intelligence/reporting/copy-report.html)

questions.question: Which feature makes an HR service available to employees in Employee Center Pro?
questions.explanation:
An HR service intended for employee self-service requires an HR catalog item, also known as a record producer. The record producer is the employee-facing mechanism through which employees request the service from Employee Center.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: HR services](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/hr-service-administration.html)

questions.question: Which application lets you analyze trends, patterns, and data on the Team Insights page?
questions.explanation:
Manager Hub includes the Team Insights capability, which provides charts and other visualizations of aggregated team statistics and trends for managers.

**Learn more:** [Use Manager Hub](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/use-manager-hub.html) · [Manager Hub release notes](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/store-release-notes/store-rn-hr-manager-hub.html)

questions.question: Which of the following statements are true for an HR application regarding the User [sys_user] table and the HR Profile [sn_hr_core.profile] table?

options.label: B
options.text: Only HR Profile table is required in HR.

options.label: D
options.text: Only the User table is required in HR.

questions.explanation:
HR Profile records are associated with employee records in the User [sys_user] table. The User record holds the employee identity and shared employment information, while the HR Profile holds confidential HR-specific information; both are required for the HR record model.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Customized profile information](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_CustomizedProfileInformation.html) · [ServiceNow: HR Profile](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/c_HRProfileRecords.html)

questions.question: In the base ServiceNow configuration, when are HR Cases generated after a Bulk HR case request has been submitted?

options.label: A
options.text: Twice per day using a scheduled job

options.label: B
options.text: Every 6 hours using a scheduled job

options.label: C
options.text: Once a day using a scheduled job

questions.explanation: The Bulk Case Creation scheduled job processes submitted bulk HR case requests. In the base configuration, its default execution interval is every six hours, although administrators can change that schedule.
